news.title: Chelsea Football Club announces multi-year sleeve partnership with Sokin
news.title_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部宣布与索金建立多年袖标合作伙伴关系
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club can today announce a multi-year partnership with Sokin, the embedded finance and payments company used by businesses worldwide. Sokin will be named a Principal Partner and Official Business Payments and FX Partner of Chelsea FC and Chelsea FC Women. As a Principal Partner, Sokin will be represented on the sleeves of the Chelsea FC men’s, women’s and academy home, away, and third kits from the 2026/27 season. The partnership brings together two ambitious London-headquartered organisations with worldwide reach – a club with millions of fans across the world and a fintech platform through which businesses move more than $11 billion a year. A club of Chelsea’s scale works in many currencies every day, with partners, competitions and supporters around the world, and needs a financial partner built to handle that. Sokin gives finance teams business payments, multi-currency accounts, foreign exchange, checkout and treasury in one place, so they spend less time juggling banks and providers and keep more of what they move. As Official Business Payments and FX Partner, Sokin will simplify how Chelsea FC sends, receives and manages money in the currencies the club operates in. The Sokin logo will feature on the sleeve of the Chelsea shirt for the first time when the men’s team host Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 24 October. Jason Gannon, President at Chelsea FC, said: 'At Chelsea, we seek to partner with organisations that share our ambition and innovative mindset. Sokin’s expertise in business payments, and their focus on making both simpler for the businesses they serve, makes them a natural fit for the Club. We are pleased to welcome Sokin to the Chelsea family and look forward to working together in the years ahead.' Vroon Modgill, CEO and founder at Sokin, said: 'Chelsea plays on the biggest stage in world football, and its business runs in dozens of currencies. Sokin was built for that with regulated, multi-currency payments and foreign exchange for organisations that operate internationally. 'We’re proud to be the platform behind the business payments and FX of one of the most iconic teams in football. Sokin’s platform serves businesses in more than 170 countries. We’re thrilled to be partners for the season ahead. An organisation as sophisticated as Chelsea doesn’t leave its finances to chance.'
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部今天宣布与 Sokin 建立多年合作伙伴关系，Sokin 是一家被全球企业使用的嵌入式金融和支付公司。 Sokin 将被任命为切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西足球俱乐部女子足球俱乐部的主要合作伙伴以及官方商业支付和外汇合作伙伴。作为主要合作伙伴，索金将出现在切尔西足球俱乐部 2026/27 赛季的男子、女子和青训营主场、客场以及第三套球衣的袖子上。此次合作将两个雄心勃勃、总部位于伦敦、业务遍及全球的组织结合在一起——一个是在全球拥有数百万球迷的俱乐部，另一个是企业每年转移超过 110 亿美元的金融科技平台。切尔西这样规模的俱乐部每天都以多种货币开展业务，与世界各地的合作伙伴、赛事和支持者合作，需要一个能够处理这些问题的金融合作伙伴。 Sokin 为财务团队提供了业务支付、多币种账户、外汇、结帐和金库于一处的服务，因此他们可以减少在银行和提供商之间周旋的时间，并保留更多的流动资金。作为官方商业支付和外汇合作伙伴，Sokin 将简化切尔西足球俱乐部以俱乐部运营货币发送、接收和管理资金的方式。当 10 月 24 日星期六，切尔西男队在斯坦福桥迎战托特纳姆热刺队时，Sokin 徽标将首次出现在切尔西球衣的袖子上。切尔西足球俱乐部主席杰森·甘农 (Jason Gannon) 表示：“在切尔西，我们寻求与与我们拥有共同雄心和创新思维的组织合作。 Sokin 在商业支付方面的专业知识，以及他们致力于让他们所服务的企业变得更简单，使他们成为俱乐部的天然人选。我们很高兴欢迎索金加入切尔西大家庭，并期待在未来的岁月里共同努力。” Sokin 首席执行官兼创始人 Vroon Modgill 表示：“切尔西在世界足球最大的舞台上踢球，其业务以数十种货币运行。 Sokin 专为国际运营组织提供受监管的多币种支付和外汇而构建。 “我们很自豪能够成为足球界最具标志性的球队之一的商业支付和外汇背后的平台。 Sokin 的平台为 170 多个国家的企业提供服务。我们很高兴能成为下一季的合作伙伴。像切尔西这样复杂的组织不会让其财务状况听天由命。”

news.title: Alonso targeting a ‘complete’ performance to continue good run
news.title_zh: 阿隆索的目标是“完整”的表现以继续良好的表现
news.body_en: Tottenham Hotspur's visit to Stamford Bridge tomorrow is the first of three high-profile fixtures in the space of the week for Xabi Alonso's side – and the Blues manager has stressed the qualities that must be shown to start with a positive result. We have lost to the side from north London just once in our past 41 meetings in SW6, but Alonso knows that record counts for nothing come kick-off on Saturday, when a new chapter in the rivalry will be written. With the Blues targeting a third straight league success for the first time since the start of this year, and Tottenham hoping to pick up a second victory this week, there is plenty on the line. Alonso knows what to expect. ‘We need to have a very complete game,’ he said. ‘Offensively, defensively, mentality-wise going through difficult moments, as there will be moments for everything. ‘We need to prove again we can continue our run, knowing it’s a special game. We need to play with our head, heart, with intelligence but with passionate energy. We will need many things tomorrow.’ On Tottenham, Alonso added: ‘I’ve seen a good team even in bad results, so we’re expecting a tough game against good opposition who do many good things. 'We need to be prepared for what to do in different moments with the ball. It’s going to be game eight [in the Premier League this season], so it’s still early days for everything.’ The meeting with Tottenham is the first of three high-profile fixtures in quick succession. Next week we travel to Liverpool in the Carabao Cup fourth round before hosting Manchester United. Alonso is excited for what is to come, and wants to see his side rise to the challenge and prove their credentials. ‘It was a matter of time until we had big games and this week we have three massive games against top clubs. This happens in the Premier League; this is not news. So we take it step by step, and we start tomorrow.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. news.body_zh: 托特纳姆热刺队明天做客斯坦福桥是哈维·阿隆索球队本周三场备受瞩目的比赛中的第一场——蓝军主帅强调了必须展现出的品质才能取得积极的结果。在过去 41 场 SW6 比赛中，我们只输给了来自北伦敦的球队一次，但阿隆索知道，周六开赛时，纪录没有任何意义，届时比赛将谱写新的篇章。蓝军的目标是自今年年初以来首次取得联赛三连胜，而托特纳姆热刺则希望在本周取得第二场胜利，因此有很多机会。阿隆索知道会发生什么。 “我们需要一场非常完整的比赛，”他说。 “在进攻、防守、心态上都要经历困难时刻，因为一切都会有时刻。 “我们需要再次证明我们可以继续我们的比赛，因为我们知道这是一场特殊的比赛。我们需要用我们的头脑、心灵、智慧和热情来玩耍。明天我们需要很多东西。”在托特纳姆热刺队中，阿隆索补充道：“我见过一支优秀的球队，即使成绩很差，所以我们期待一场艰难的比赛，对手是出色的对手，他们做了很多好事。” “我们需要为不同时刻拿球时该做什么做好准备。这将是（本赛季英超联赛）的第八场比赛，所以一切都还为时尚早。”与托特纳姆热刺队的比赛是连续三场备受瞩目的比赛中的第一场。下周我们将前往利物浦参加卡拉宝杯第四轮比赛，然后主场迎战曼联。阿隆索对即将发生的事情感到兴奋，并希望看到他的球队迎接挑战并证明他们的实力。 “我们迟早会举行大型比赛，本周我们将与顶级俱乐部进行三场大型比赛。这种情况发生在英超联赛中；这不是新闻。所以我们一步一步来，明天开始。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Ticketing update
news.title_zh: 票务更新
news.body_en: As part of our commitment to provide transparency for our supporters across our ticketing policies and procedures, Chelsea FC is pleased to share an update on the progress of the newly introduced systems so far this season. The ticket application window was introduced for men's team matches for the 2026/27 season following supporter feedback regarding the ticketing process. After extensive fan consultation with multiple fan groups, the Fan Advisory Board and a supporter town hall, the ticket application window has been established to streamline the ticket purchase journey, make it fairer and more accessible for genuine Chelsea fans to purchase tickets, and reduce the risk of bot and tout activity. Similar systems are operated by a number of other Premier League clubs. We are pleased to share the results of the first six ticket application windows this season, to update supporters on how the process is working. Based on the data available for the ticket application windows this season, an eligible member applying for an individual match ticket via the ticket application window stood a 68% chance of securing a ticket. Overall, 99% of eligible members who applied for every Premier League game, have successfully secured at least one ticket, via the ticket application window, the ticket exchange or ticket forwarding, demonstrating the system provides greater opportunity for a larger number of fans to attend matches at Stamford Bridge. So far this season, of all fans who have applied in at least one ticket application window, 80% have secured a ticket for at least one match. The most in-demand fixtures are sold using a loyalty point threshold, to prioritise loyalty and regular match-going supporters. For the Manchester United and Tottenham Hotspur fixtures, 46% of tickets were allocated to those who fell within the top 10% of total accumulated loyalty points. The ticket exchange and ticket forwarding function provides an additional route for supporters to access tickets. For those who were unsuccessful in the ticket application window, the ticket exchange represents a second chance of securing a ticket, with unsuccessful applicants having a minimum 48-hour priority window. We want to ensure genuine Chelsea fans are able to access tickets and we encourage all our supporters to use the ticket exchange and ticket forwarding to do so. For more information on using these mechanisms,  you can view our How-to Guides by clicking here. We also want to ensure that the next generation of Chelsea supporters have more opportunity to come to Stamford Bridge. So far this season, 76% of Junior Blue members who have applied in the ticket application window have been successful in securing at least one match ticket. The club continues to clamp down on ticket touting. In previous seasons, we have seen up to 80,000 bots per game attempt to access tickets online. Now, with the introduction of the ticket application window those using automated purchasing software are prevented from accessing on-sale windows and it enables increased monitoring of accounts to identify suspicious activity. We also continue to operate ticket collection points at home and away fixtures. So far this season, we have seen a 93% non-collection rate, demonstrating that our ongoing work to identify suspicious or fraudulent accounts is working. Using this data and supporter feedback, the club will continue to review our ticketing policies and processes, sharing regular insights with the Fan Advisory Board and updating Fans’ Forums.
news.body_zh: 作为我们致力于为球迷提供票务政策和程序透明度的承诺的一部分，切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴分享本赛季迄今为止新引入的系统的最新进展。根据球迷对票务流程的反馈，2026/27 赛季男子团体比赛引入了门票申请窗口。经过与多个球迷团体、球迷咨询委员会和支持者市政厅进行广泛的球迷咨询后，设立了门票申请窗口，以简化门票购买流程，让真正的切尔西球迷更公平、更容易地购买门票，并降低机器人和兜售活动的风险。许多其他英超俱乐部也运营类似的系统。我们很高兴分享本赛季前六个门票申请窗口的结果，以便支持者了解该流程的最新情况。根据本赛季门票申请窗口的数据，符合资格的会员通过门票申请窗口申请个人比赛门票的机会为 68%。总体而言，申请每场英超比赛的合格会员中有99%通过门票申请窗口、门票交换或门票转发成功获得至少一张门票，这表明该系统为更多球迷观看斯坦福桥比赛提供了更多机会。本赛季到目前为止，在至少一个门票申请窗口申请过的所有球迷中，80% 的人已经获得了至少一场比赛的门票。最受欢迎的比赛按照忠诚度积分阈值进行出售，以优先考虑忠诚度和定期参加比赛的支持者。对于曼联和托特纳姆热刺队的比赛，46% 的门票分配给了累计忠诚度积分排名前 10% 的会员。门票兑换和门票转发功能为支持者获取门票提供了额外的途径。对于那些在门票申请窗口中未成功申请的人来说，换票是获得门票的第二次机会，未成功的申请人有至少 48 小时的优先窗口。我们希望确保真正的切尔西球迷能够获得门票，并鼓励所有支持者使用门票交换和门票转发来获得门票。有关使用这些机制的更多信息，您可以单击此处查看我们的操作指南。我们还希望确保下一代切尔西球迷有更多机会来到斯坦福桥。本赛季到目前为止，在门票申请窗口申请的 Junior Blue 会员中有 76% 成功获得了至少一张比赛门票。俱乐部继续打击倒卖门票行为。在前几个赛季中，我们发现每场比赛有多达 80,000 个机器人尝试在线获取门票。现在，随着门票申请窗口的引入，那些使用自动购买软件的人将无法访问销售窗口，并且可以加强对帐户的监控以识别可疑活动。我们还继续运营主场和客场比赛的售票点。本季度到目前为止，我们的未收款率为 93%，这表明我们正在进行的识别可疑或欺诈账户的工作正在发挥作用。利用这些数据和支持者的反馈，俱乐部将继续审查我们的票务政策和流程，与球迷咨询委员会定期分享见解并更新球迷论坛。

news.title: Xabi Alonso says Mike Penders is ready to show his qualities
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索表示迈克·彭德斯已准备好展示他的品质
news.body_en: Mike Penders is expected to start his first Premier League game when Chelsea meet Tottenham tomorrow, and Xabi Alonso is confident the 21-year-old is prepared for the challenge that awaits. Penders was introduced midway through the second half of our victory at Everton last weekend, becoming our youngest Premier League goalkeeper. He replaced Emi Martinez, who took a heavy blow to the face and has subsequently undergone surgery on his jaw. With Martinez out for what Alonso says will be a ‘few weeks’, Penders is set to don the gloves for the Blues, with a mouthwatering London derby up first. ‘He is ready,’ said Alonso in his pre-match press conference. ‘He has been training well and played a couple of cup games where he showed he has a good level. Even the other day when he came on against Everton, he showed in a few minutes his personality and qualities. ‘This is why we have a squad, to be ready for these kinds of situations, and we are fully convinced that Mike can play very well. He is a goalkeeper for now and for the future. We are looking to the next games and are happy with Mike. He is prepared.’ Penders’ assimilation into English football has been aided in the past couple of months by Martinez, who brings a vast wealth of knowledge and know-how with him. Alonso explained how the Argentinean has helped Penders, who spent last season on loan at Strasbourg having signed for Chelsea in the summer of 2024. ‘He has the support and is learning from an experienced goalkeeper in Emi, who is having a great impact on the team and on Mike. ‘That happens in a very natural way. It’s not that we say, “Dibu, you have to be a mentor and you have this certificate.” It happens naturally, spontaneously every day because Emi likes to talk, not just with the other goalkeepers, but defenders as well. ‘He is very communicative and he likes to have this sense that they are close. So it’s happening.’ 'It has been noted that Penders bears similarities to former Chelsea goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois, who Alonso worked with at Real Madrid. Our manager agrees there are resemblances between the two beyond simply their appearance and nationality. ‘The stature, both left-footed, both dominant in the air,’ Alonso pointed out. ‘I spoke with Thibaut when he was at the World Cup and asked about Mike, and he said himself that he could see the resemblance with Mike. 'We need to help him, support him, but for sure he is a goalkeeper for the present and the future.’ Don't miss your chance to experience the London derby in VIP style. Limited Club Chelsea tickets remain – book now to be at the Bridge.
news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯预计将在明天切尔西对阵托特纳姆热刺时首发他的首场英超比赛，哈维·阿隆索相信这位 21 岁的球员已经为即将到来的挑战做好了准备。上周末我们战胜埃弗顿的比赛下半场中段，潘德斯登场，成为我们最年轻的英超门将。他接替了埃米·马丁内斯，后者脸部受到重击，随后下巴接受了手术。阿隆索表示，马丁内斯将缺席“几周”，潘德斯将为蓝军戴上手套，首先将进行一场令人垂涎的伦敦德比。 “他已经准备好了，”阿隆索在赛前新闻发布会上说道。 “他训练得很好，参加了几场杯赛，证明了自己的水平很高。即使在前几天对阵埃弗顿的比赛中，他也能在几分钟内展现出自己的个性和品质。 “这就是为什么我们有一支球队，为这种情况做好准备，我们完全相信迈克可以打得很好。他是现在和未来的守门员。我们正在期待接下来的比赛，并对迈克感到满意。他已经做好了准备。过去几个月，马丁内斯帮助彭德斯融入了英国足球，马丁内斯带来了丰富的知识和技巧。阿隆索解释了阿根廷人如何帮助潘德斯，潘德斯上赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡，并于 2024 年夏天签约切尔西。 ‘这以一种非常自然的方式发生。我们并不是说，“迪布，你必须成为一名导师，并且你有这个证书。”这种事情每天都会自然而然地发生，因为埃米不仅喜欢与其他守门员交谈，还喜欢与后卫交谈。 “他非常善于沟通，他喜欢有一种他们很亲密的感觉。 “人们注意到，潘德斯与阿隆索在皇家马德里共事过的前切尔西门将蒂博·库尔图瓦有相似之处。”我们的经理同意，除了外表和国籍之外，两人之间还存在相似之处。 “身材，都是左脚，都在空中占主导地位，”阿隆索指出。 “当蒂博参加世界杯时，我与他交谈并询问了迈克的情况，他自己说他可以看到与迈克的相似之处。 “我们需要帮助他，支持他，但可以肯定的是，他是现在和未来的门将。” 不要错过以 VIP 方式体验伦敦德比的机会。切尔西俱乐部门票数量有限——立即预订即可在桥上购买。

news.title: Xabi Alonso confirms Chelsea team news for Tottenham
news.title_zh: 哈比·阿隆索确认了切尔西队为托特纳姆热刺队的消息
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso confirmed Blues defender Malo Gusto is in contention to face Tottenham Hotspur tomorrow and provided updates on the fitness of Pep Chavarria, Emmanuel Emegha and Emi Martinez. The Blues welcome an old foe to Stamford Bridge tomorrow afternoon as Roberto De Zerbi brings his Spurs side to west London. We enter the game after impressive back-to-back top-flight victories: the first a 5-1 win over Bournemouth and the second a 2-0 triumph at Everton. Tottenham, meanwhile, recorded their first Premier League win of the campaign last time out. However, they are winless on the road this season. Alonso, who undertook his pre-match press conference duties after today's training session at Cobham, confirmed that Gusto was fit to return after missing our win on Merseyside last weekend. Chavarria, though, will remain absent. 'Malo is fine,' the Blues manager explained. 'Pep is training a little bit more, but he is not going to make it [for the Tottenham game]. Emegha will also miss out. The striker has yet to feature since arriving this summer, but is making progress in his comeback. ‘He’s feeling better, but we need to wait,' said Alonso. There will be no Martinez against Tottenham – or for a few weeks – due to the injury the Argentine sustained against Everton in a collision with Jarrad Branthwaite. Martinez was stretchered off in the second half and was taken to hospital for further checks, after which he underwent surgery on his jaw. Alonso confirmed the goalkeeper is doing well, but he will be sidelined for the matches ahead. 'Emi is doing better,' he said. 'He had the surgery and day by day he is feeling better, but we still need to wait. A few weeks. Hopefully, less than more, but we need to wait. 'The good thing is that he is feeling better and we need to listen to his feelings, the opinions of the doctors, the specialists, the surgeons. Considering it was a bad one, he is doing good.' news.title: Lexi Potter on learnings from Keira Walsh and facing her former side
news.title_zh: 莱克西·波特向凯拉·沃尔什学习并面对她以前的一面
news.body_en: If there ever was an ideal role model for a young midfielder in the women’s game, it would be serial winner Keira Walsh. Our Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter is now learning alongside her in the Blues first team, and she is thriving. It’s more than just master and apprentice, though. Potter’s calm head and confidence on the ball in the holding role has allowed Walsh to play higher up the pitch, to great success. When we sat down with the 20-year-old prodigy, she gave some insight into how the pair work together, and also into the general mood inside the camp at Chelsea. ‘Keira gives me a lot of confidence when I’m playing alongside her,’ Potter told us. ‘Especially when I'm receiving the ball out of possession. She gives me a lot of good information. We see the game in a similar way, and we're on the same page a lot of the time when we’re trying to progress the ball forward from a central area. ‘We’re in a really nice place as a team. For a while now, it's been really positive, and I think you can see it in the performances that everyone's working and fighting for each other.’ This Sunday, we face newly-promoted Crystal Palace away from home. Potter is best qualified to talk about the Eagles, having helped them earn promotion to the Women’s Super League in 2023/24. She immediately returned for a second season-long loan, gaining valuable experience in the WSL. Now, they are back in the top flight and the midfielder passes along some insight on what to expect from them. ‘I think it'll be a good game,’ she says. 'Having been at the club for two seasons, I know a few of the girls, and I’m looking forward to the game. ‘It was really special to be involved in their promotion. It was my first year in senior football, and I really enjoyed that season. I had a lot of opportunities, which I was grateful for. It was a really good season, and I  enjoyed it. ‘I was only 17, so I wasn't allowed to go for the full celebrations. But yeah, they were good; they were fun. It was a nice end to a good season. ‘The second season was a slightly different season to the first one. It was obviously a lot harder teams that we played. In terms of competition for places, it was a lot harder, and it was a different mindset. Potter added: ‘Getting minutes in the WSL at Palace really helped me because playing time is so valuable when you are developing. That exposure to the WSL really helped me during the loan. ‘When you’re a newly-promoted side, playing against the big teams was a really big challenge, and that’s always good for long-term development. I'm still in touch with a couple of the girls. I know Aimee (Everett), the captain, quite well and I speak to her fairly regularly. She really looked after me when I was there. ‘A few of the staff members there were really like impactful and really beneficial for me and my journey. I'm very lucky to have crossed paths with a lot of good people at the club. ‘They've had a good start to the season. They've picked up some really good results, so they'll put up a good challenge. They'll defend well, and we need to be on our game and try and break them down.’ Having now cemented her place in the Blues first team, our discussion concluded with our question about what she would say to any young players in the Chelsea Academy who are hoping to follow in her footsteps. ‘I'd say work hard and be patient,’ she concluded. ‘Your time will come. You just have to stay ready and work hard for it.’
news.body_zh: 如果女足比赛中的年轻中场球员有一个理想的榜样，那就是连续冠军凯拉·沃尔什。我们的切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特现在正在蓝军一线队与她一起学习，她正在蓬勃发展。不过，这不仅仅是师徒关系。波特冷静的头脑和控球的信心让沃尔什能够在球场上踢得更高，并取得了巨大的成功。当我们与这位 20 岁的天才坐下来交谈时，她对两人如何合作以及切尔西训练营内的总体气氛进行了一些深入的了解。 “当我和凯拉一起打球时，凯拉给了我很大的信心，”波特告诉我们。 “尤其是当我在失控状态下接球时。她给了我很多有用的信息。我们以类似的方式看待比赛，当我们试图从中心区域向前推进球时，我们很多时候都在同一页面上。 “作为一个团队，我们处于一个非常好的位置。一段时间以来，情况确实很积极，我想你可以从每个人的表现中看到这一点，每个人都在为彼此努力和奋斗。”本周日，我们将在客场迎战升班马水晶宫。波特最有资格谈论老鹰队，她帮助他们在 2023/24 赛季晋升到女子超级联赛。她立即​​回归，获得了第二个赛季的租借，在 WSL 中获得了宝贵的经验。现在，他们回到了顶级联赛，这位中场球员分享了一些关于他们的期望的见解。 “我认为这将是一场精彩的比赛，”她说。 “在俱乐部呆了两个赛季，我认识一些女孩，我很期待这场比赛。 “参与他们的促销活动真的很特别。这是我参加成年足球比赛的第一年，我真的很喜欢那个赛季。我有很多机会，我很感激。那真是一个美好的赛季，我很享受。 “我当时只有 17 岁，所以我不被允许参加完整的庆祝活动。但是，是的，他们很好；他们很有趣。这是一个美好赛季的美好结局。 “第二季与第一季略有不同。显然我们对阵的球队要困难得多。就名额竞争而言，难度更大，心态也不同。波特补充道：“在水晶宫的 WSL 中获得上场时间确实对我很有帮助，因为当你在进步时，上场时间非常宝贵。在贷款期间接触 WSL 确实对我有帮助。 “当你是一支新晋级球队时，与强队比赛是一个非常大的挑战，这对于长期发展总是有好处的。我仍然和几个女孩保持着联系。我很了解船长艾米（埃弗雷特饰），我也经常和她交谈。当我在那里时，她真的很照顾我。 “那里的一些工作人员确实很有影响力，对我和我的旅程非常有益。我很幸运能够在俱乐部遇到很多优秀的人。 ‘他们本赛季有一个良好的开局。他们已经取得了一些非常好的成绩，所以他们将提出很好的挑战。他们会防守得很好，我们需要在比赛中努力击败他们。”现在巩固了她在蓝军一线队的地位，我们的讨论最后提出了这样的问题：她会对切尔西青训营中任何希望追随她脚步的年轻球员说些什么。 “我想说的是努力工作并保持耐心，”她总结道。 ‘你的时刻将会到来。你只需要做好准备并为之努力。”

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce that Cobham Next Gen goalkeeper Freddy Bernal has signed a new contract, keeping him at the club until at least June 2029. Having joined Chelsea’s Academy as an Under-8, Bernal became a full-time scholar in 2025/26 and established himself for the Under-18s, winning the Under-18s Premier League title at Stamford Bridge. Bernal has since become a consistent presence between the sticks for Cobham Next Gen, making eight appearances so far and keeping a clean sheet in our latest EFL Trophy clash against Reading. The 18-year-old also gained valuable European experience last season in the UEFA Youth League, producing some standout performances against Bayern Munich, Benfica and Ajax. A reliable presence in goal, Bernal has demonstrated maturity throughout his progression at Chelsea. His form has also been recognised internationally with regular invitations to England youth camps. Having previously represented the Young Lions at Under-17 and Under-18 level, he featured for the Under-19s during the September and October international window.

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek eight

news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which Blues players are the best value-for-money picks, why Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is Chelsea’s most popular player this week and who you should captain in Gameweek 8. The deadline is 6.30pm BST on Friday ahead of Nottingham Forest’s trip to Ipswich Town. Morgan Rogers (£8.0m) is the most popular Chelsea player ahead of Gameweek 8 with over 170,000 transfers in. The Englishman has risen in price to £8.0m after starting the season at £7.5m and is the most-selected midfielder in Fantasy, with an ownership of over 48%. No Chelsea player has registered more expected goal involvement (xGI) than Rogers’ tally of 3.43; on top of that, he has notched 19 shots and created an impressive 13 chances. In an Aston Villa shirt, Rogers picked up three attacking returns in four starts against Spurs. Also proving popular is Pedro Neto (£6.5m) following his 15-point return last time out. The Portugal international scored twice and notched maximum bonus points. He was the highest-scoring player in the game in GW7. Neto has had four big chances, putting him second among all Blues players. Over 130,000 managers have purchased the right-wing back. With Bukayo Saka flagged as an injury doubt, Cole Palmer (£9.7m) will no doubt be in demand as the deadline approaches. The Chelsea number 10 is averaging just under six points per match in 26/27 and is yet to blank at Stamford Bridge, picking up a goal and three assists at home. Josh Acheampong (£4.5m) has started each of the last two Gameweeks and played his part in the Blues’ first clean sheet of the season. The England under-21 international picked up defensive contribution points against Everton, the second time he has reached the threshold in four starts. At just £4.5m, Acheampong has the potential to provide very good value in your FPL defence. In goal, Mike Penders (£4.4m) looks set to start with Emi Martinez (£5.0m) undergoing surgery for a fractured jaw. If selected, the Belgian will be the cheapest starting goalkeeper in the entire game. Spurs have scored just once in three away matches so far this season. Outside of Chelsea players, Erling Haaland (£15.7m) is a reliable captaincy option for Man City’s Saturday lunchtime trip to Aston Villa. The Norwegian has scored in six consecutive Gameweeks with eight goals, two double-digit hauls, 12 bonus points and 56 Fantasy points in that time. Haaland has been passed fit in the pre-Gameweek press conference. No player has had more shots on target or xGI than the league’s top scorer. Elsewhere, Morgan Gibbs-White (£7.9m) is an intriguing, differential option against Ipswich Town. Oliver Glasner confirmed in his press conference on Wednesday that the Nottingham Forest talisman is fit and available after missing GW7 with a knock. No player has created more big chances than Gibbs-White (7), who has picked up three attacking returns in three away matches. Opponents Ipswich are yet to keep a clean sheet so far this season.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们将了解哪些蓝军球员是最具性价比的球员，为什么摩根·罗杰斯（800 万英镑）是本周切尔西最受欢迎的球员，以及您应该在第八场比赛中担任队长。截止日期为英国夏令时间周五下午 6 点 30 分，在诺丁汉森林前往伊普斯维奇镇之前。摩根·罗杰斯（800万英镑）是第8场比赛之前最受欢迎的切尔西球员，转会次数超过17万。这位英国人在赛季开始时的身价为750万英镑，身价已升至800万英镑，也是Fantasy中最受欢迎的中场球员，拥有超过48%的股份。没有切尔西球员的预期进球参与度 (xGI) 超过罗杰斯的 3.43；除此之外，他还完成了 19 次射门并创造了令人印象深刻的 13 次机会。身穿阿斯顿维拉球衣的罗杰斯在对阵热刺的四场比赛中取得了三次进攻回报。佩德罗·内托（Pedro Neto）（650万英镑）在上次比赛中拿下15分后也很受欢迎。这位葡萄牙国脚梅开二度并获得最高积分。他是GW7比赛中得分最高的球员。内托有四次绝佳机会，在所有蓝军球员中排名第二。超过 130,000 名经理购买了这位右翼后卫。随着布卡约·萨卡被标记为伤病成疑，随着截止日期的临近，科尔·帕尔默（970万英镑）无疑将受到需求。这位切尔西的 10 号球员在 26/27 的比赛中场均得分略低于 6 分，并且在斯坦福桥尚未空白，在主场取得了 1 粒进球和 3 次助攻。约什·阿奇姆蓬（Josh Acheampong，450万英镑）在过去两周的比赛周中均首发出场，并在蓝军本赛季首场不失球的比赛中发挥了自己的作用。这位英格兰21岁以下国脚在对阵埃弗顿的比赛中获得了防守贡献分，这是他在四场首发中第二次达到这个门槛。 Acheampong 的售价仅为 450 万英镑，有潜力为您的 FPL 防守提供非常好的价值。守门员迈克·彭德斯（Mike Penders，440万英镑）看起来将首发，埃米·马丁内斯（Emi Martinez，500万英镑）正在接受下巴骨折手术。如果入选，比利时人将成为整场比赛最便宜的首发门将。本赛季到目前为止，热刺在三场客场比赛中只取得了一个进球。除了切尔西球员之外，埃尔林·哈兰德（1570万英镑）是曼城周六午餐时间对阵阿斯顿维拉的可靠队长选择。挪威人连续六周比赛取得八个进球、两次两位数进球、12 个奖励积分和 56 个幻想积分。哈兰德在比赛周前的新闻发布会上已经康复。没有任何球员的射正次数或 xGI 次数超过联盟的最佳射手。在其他地方，摩根·吉布斯-怀特（790万英镑）是对阵伊普斯维奇的一个有趣的差异化选择。奥利弗·格拉斯纳在周三的新闻发布会上证实，这位诺丁汉森林队的护身符在因撞击缺席第七届世界杯后已经恢复健康并可以上场。没有球员比吉布斯-怀特（7）创造更多的绝佳机会，他在三场客场比赛中获得了三次进攻回攻。对手伊普斯维奇本赛季迄今为止尚未保持零失球。

news.title: Morgan Rogers on bringing creativity, a ‘different’ front three and ageless Henderson
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈带来创造力、“不同”的前三名和永恒的亨德森
news.body_en: When Morgan Rogers gets the ball at his feet, there is only one thing on his mind. ‘The quickest way we can create a chance, whatever that may look like.’ That philosophy has served our No.17 superbly since his arrival at Stamford Bridge this summer. Rogers has had a telling impact in Xabi Alonso’s attack, providing four goals and four assists in his nine appearances to date. He has seamlessly adapted to life at Chelsea and has formed a potent partnership with Joao Pedro and his great mate Cole Palmer. Part of the reason it has been so successful is because of Rogers’ desire to make things happen. ‘I always want to be creative,’ he explains. ‘I always want to attack the goal and be threatening. Even if it doesn't work, even if it doesn't come off, I know I want the defenders thinking that I've got the ability to try something or something's going to happen here. ‘That's the way I've always been since I was younger. I think if someone is watching me, I'd want them to feel excited about watching the game and watching me play. ‘So I try and do everything I can in the little time or whatever time I've got on the ball, and just try and make as much of a difference as possible.’ Rogers has been aided by having his pal Palmer alongside him, as well as a striker at the top of his game in Joao Pedro. Between the three, 13 goals and ten assists have already been registered. That is some return just nine games into the campaign, and Rogers believes it is the variety of assets they bring that opponents have such difficulty dealing with. ‘A lot of it is chemistry, and I think we attack and challenge defenders in completely different ways,’ says Rogers. ‘We all want the ball in different ways. We all want different things in the game, and if they try and stop one, then the other two are going to get their joy because we're all so different. ‘If you get people that are the same and want the same, once you cut that off, you're struggling. But because we all want different things, if you try to stop Cole, then it allows me and Joao more space. If you try to stop me and Joao, then Cole's going to be free as a bird to set his authority on the game. ‘It’s kind of a mismatch for other teams of what to stop and how to stop it. We know that if we're all on it and we're all in the positive mindset of helping each other, that we're all going to get joy from the game.’ It is not only our attacking players that have caught the eye so far in 2026/27. Alonso has highlighted the importance of the collective in helping us become more robust defensively, and the addition of Jordan Henderson to our midfield in recent weeks has proven beneficial in that respect. Henderson, an England team-mate of Rogers’, covered more distance than anyone else on the pitch in our impressive recent victories over Bournemouth and Everton. His performances in a Chelsea shirt have come as no surprise to Rogers. ‘He's a special person, and a special player. People forget the player and just remember the person. They think he's here for experience and to help everyone, but people forget the player and what he's achieved in the game. ‘He can still play at the highest level. He can still outrun everyone. He’s so driven and he’s in such good shape. Thirty-six doesn’t mean anything to him, because he can still compete with 23- and 24-year-olds as he shows in training every day. ‘There’s no surprise to me that he can still impact games and impact teams because of his mentality, the way he thinks about the game, and the way he thinks about his body. 'Even if he's not at the training ground, he's thinking constantly about how he can be in the best physical and mental shape come the weekend to perform and deliver. ‘The more people talk about his age, the more fire it gives him to prove people wrong. So people need to keep calling him old and saying he's finished, because then he'll just keep getting better!’
news.body_zh: 当摩根·罗杰斯把球拿到脚下时，他脑子里只有一件事。 “无论是什么样的机会，我们都能以最快的方式创造机会。”自从今年夏天他来到斯坦福桥以来，这种理念一直为我们的 17 号球员提供了极好的服务。罗杰斯对哈维·阿隆索的进攻产生了显着的影响，迄今为止在他的九场比赛中贡献了四个进球和四次助攻。他已经无缝地适应了切尔西的生活，并与若昂·佩德罗和他的伟大队友科尔·帕尔默建立了强有力的合作伙伴关系。它如此成功的部分原因是罗杰斯渴望让事情发生。 “我总是想发挥创造力，”他解释道。 “我总是想攻击球门并具有威胁性。即使它不起作用，即使它没有成功，我知道我希望防守者认为我有能力尝试一些事情或这里会发生一些事情。 ‘从我年轻的时候起，我就一直这样。我想如果有人在观看我，我希望他们对观看比赛和观看我的比赛感到兴奋。 “所以我会尽我所能，在很短的时间内或任何我有球的时间里，尽可能地发挥作用。”罗杰斯得到了他的朋友帕尔默和他的最佳前锋若昂·佩德罗的帮助。三人之间已经打入 13 粒进球和 10 次助攻。这是赛季刚开始九场比赛就取得的回报，罗杰斯相信，正是他们带来的各种资产让对手难以应对。 “这很大程度上是化学反应，我认为我们以完全不同的方式攻击和挑战防守者，”罗杰斯说。 “我们都以不同的方式想要球。我们都想在游戏中得到不同的东西，如果他们试图阻止其中一个，那么其他两个就会得到他们的快乐，因为我们都是如此不同。 “如果你得到的人都是一样的，想要的也一样，一旦你切断了这一点，你就会陷入困境。但因为我们都想要不同的东西，如果你试图阻止科尔，那么它会给我和若奥更多的空间。如果你试图阻止我和若昂，那么科尔就会像小鸟一样自由地在比赛中树立自己的权威。 “对于其他球队来说，这在阻止什么以及如何阻止方面有点不匹配。我们知道，如果我们都全力以赴，并且都抱着互相帮助的积极心态，那么我们都会从比赛中获得快乐。” 2026/27 赛季到目前为止，吸引眼球的不仅仅是我们的进攻球员。阿隆索强调了集体对于帮助我们变得更加强大的防守的重要性，最近几周乔丹·亨德森加入我们的中场已经证明在这方面是有益的。罗杰斯的英格兰队友亨德森在我们最近战胜伯恩茅斯和埃弗顿的比赛中，跑动的距离比场上任何人都远。罗杰斯对他身披切尔西球衣的表现并不感到意外。 ‘他是一个特别的人，也是一个特别的球员。人们忘记了球员，只记住了这个人。他们认为他来这里是为了积累经验并帮助每个人，但人们忘记了球员以及他在比赛中取得的成就。 ‘他仍然可以发挥最高水平。他仍然可以超越所有人。他动力十足，而且状态很好。三十六岁对他来说并不意味着什么，因为他仍然可以与23岁和24岁的人竞争，正如他每天在训练中所表现的那样。 “他仍然能够影响比赛和球队，这对我来说并不奇怪，因为他的心态、他对比赛的看法以及他对自己身体的看法。 “即使他不在训练场上，他也会不断思考如何在周末保持最佳的身体和精神状态来表现和交付。 “人们越多谈论他的年龄，他就越想证明人们是错的。”所以人们需要继续称他老了，并说他已经完蛋了，因为那样他就会不断变得更好！

news.body_en: The highlight of a fantastic 4-0 win over Manchester United exactly a decade ago was N'Golo Kante's first Chelsea goal. The Blues were already three goals to the good - courtesy of Pedro, Gary Cahill and Eden Hazard - when Kante danced between a static defence and coolly slotted his finish into the bottom corner. The goal was met with a huge roar inside Stamford Bridge, with the loveable Kante mobbed by his team-mates after opening his Chelsea account a few months into what turned out to be a glittering Blues career. Although best known for his work winning possession back and foiling the opposition, Kante was also an excellent finisher, and this goal showcased his preference for placement over power. In total, the French World Cup winner scored 13 times in 269 Chelsea appearances. This was one of the most memorable, and you can watch the highlights of a fantastic victory at the Bridge below!
news.body_zh: 整整十年前，恩戈洛·坎特在切尔西 4-0 战胜曼联的比赛中打进了第一个进球。在佩德罗、加里·卡希尔和伊登·阿扎尔的帮助下，蓝军已经领先三球，坎特在静止的防守中起舞，冷静地将射门打入球门底角。这个进球在斯坦福桥球场内引起了巨大的轰动，可爱的坎特在开启他的切尔西账户几个月后就被他的队友围攻，而他的蓝军生涯才刚刚开始。尽管坎特以夺回控球权和挫败对手而闻名，但他也是一名出色的终结者，这个进球展示了他对位置而非力量的偏好。这位法国世界杯冠军在为切尔西出场的 269 场比赛中总共打入 13 球。这是最令人难忘的一场比赛，您可以在下面的桥上观看精彩胜利的精彩片段！

news.body_en: It is derby day at Stamford Bridge on Saturday when Chelsea host capital rivals Tottenham Hotspur in west London. Here are all the key facts and figures you need ahead of kick-off. Chelsea go into our eighth Premier League match of the season having moved up to fourth place in the table. We are one point ahead of Liverpool in fifth. Saturday’s opponents Spurs are in 16th, with one win and three draws so far. Chelsea have won our last six Premier League games against Spurs and are aiming for a seventh straight league win for the first time in our history. Chelsea are unbeaten in our past 10 Premier League meetings with Tottenham when scoring first (nine wins, one draw). The Blues have won more games in all competitions against Tottenham than we have against any other club (83). We have scored 124 goals in 68 Premier League games against Tottenham, more than against any other opponent. Since 1990, Chelsea have lost just once in 41 home matches against Tottenham in all competitions, winning 27 and drawing 13. That sole defeat came in April 2018. Tottenham have won one of their past 15 Premier League games against Chelsea (with two draws, 12 defeats), a 2-0 home win in February 2023. In last season’s corresponding fixture in May, Enzo Fernandez and Andrey Santos gave us a two-goal lead, before Richarlison pulled one back for Spurs in the 74th minute. It ended 2-1. In the last match at Everton, for the second consecutive week, we scored in the opening minute of the second half. The Blues have lost one of our last 16 Premier League London derbies at Stamford Bridge (11 wins, four draws), going unbeaten in eight since a 2-1 defeat to Fulham on Boxing Day 2024. Our 25 goals in nine league and cup games this season are our most at this stage since scoring 29 under Carlo Ancelotti in 2010/11. No Premier League team’s matches have produced more goals after seven matchweeks than Chelsea’s 30, comprising 17 scored and 13 conceded. Jordan Henderson covered more ground than any other player in each of our last two matches - 11.9km against Bournemouth and 12km against Everton. Chelsea’s clean sheet at Everton was our first in the Premier League for exactly nine months and our first away from home since Bournemouth on 6 December 2025. news.title: Nike Reflective Pack launches – for Lions After Dark

news.body_en: Winter is on its way for many Chelsea fans but a new Nike collection is a beacon of light as the darkness descends. This sports and outdoor wear cannot fail to catch the eye as it is worn here today by Levi Colwill, Manaka Matsukubo, Wesley Fofana and Malo Gusto. Shop online or in store to join these players in standing out when the lights go down. Crucial to these designs for Lions After Dark is the reflective detailing that catches the light so effectively, almost seeming to ignite under the cover of night. Brightest of all are the hooded fleece jacket and the matching track pants. Contrasting with its blue eclipse colour are the signature reflective elements: a pair of diagonal stripes plus sleeve pocket trim and a shining club badge and Nike swoosh that cannot fail to get you noticed. Tailored specifically for women, we have the dark blue Phoenix hoodie which also features the reflective crest and swoosh. Providing outer protection as well as fluorescent flashes are the Therma-FIT vest and the fill jacket. Marking those out from the crowd is a highly reflective Nike design on the back, which is accompanied by CFC lettering loud and proud. The vest and jacket are predominantly black, as is the collection’s t-shirt which has a metallic take on the swoosh and CFC. It is a return to the blue eclipse shade for the holiday sweater which tones down the logo on its textured front. Completing this winter range are a matching cap, beanie and kids’ sizes for the fleece jacket, track pants and t-shirt. The Nike Reflective Pack is for those who own the darkness. For those who refuse to blend in. Shop it now by visiting our online store or make the trip to the Megastore at Stamford Bridge.

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Crystal Palace press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在水晶宫前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash against Crystal Palace on Sunday, and here are the key talking points from what the Blues head coach said. For the fourth game in a row in the Women’s Super League, this Sunday brings a London derby for the Blues, as we travel away to Crystal Palace on a run of five consecutive wins in that competition. Bompastor confirmed that with the exception of Naomi Girma – who is recovering from a calf injury – every member of the squad is in contention to be involved against the Eagles, including potential debutant and Ballon d’Or nominee Manaka Matsukubo. Here are the rest of the key talking points from our head coach’s pre-match press conference on Thursday. ‘I think we need to carry over the confidence. Right now we are a team who is playing with confidence on the pitch. ‘On the defensive aspects probably on Sunday we didn't have time enough to remind everyone in terms of the game model what we wanted to achieve in all of the aspects of the defensive phase. It was a quick turnaround with the Tottenham game, but we had a good review with the players. ‘I think in possession of the ball we are carrying the fact we are creating a lot of opportunities in every game we are playing right now and we are being clinical and ruthless in the box as well. ‘So we need to carry over those positives going to the Sunday game.’ 'Giulia is a young, talented player. She joined us in the summer. I think for now you didn't have the opportunity to see her a lot with us. It means, again, right now I have a lot of players available and the competition is high in the squad. 'I'm really happy with Giulia joining us. I think sometimes for young players it takes a little while to settle in the team and to be able to get those minutes and to become a more important player for us, but I'm really pleased with Giulia's mentality. 'I think on and off the pitch she's a great person, great player. When she is on the pitch she works really hard. I'm really pleased with her mindset and mentality. She always wants to work hard, she always wants to improve, she's always keen to do more and I think, joining us, she's in a good place right now. 'I'm hoping for her to be able to get some minutes, some exposure. She played some minutes, but probably not at the level she would like to. But I'm confident because she has the right mindset and she's working with the right mentality. 'So I know these opportunities will come. I know she will be ready to take the opportunities and to show what she's capable of, and the quality she has as a player as well.' ‘Ellie is performing at a really good level. She's got two goals from her left foot, which is unusual. So right now she's performing at a really good level, being able to impact the game the way we want to play as a team. ‘She's really important out of possession and in possession, being able to repeat the efforts in that corridor. I think she brings a lot in possession of the ball, she always has this mindset and mentality to go forward. ‘She has a lot of pace, she's improving a lot in terms of the technical aspects. She's now able to deliver really good crosses, but also to be in the box and to be clinical to score some goals. ‘I'm not sure she can have a bigger impact than what she's doing right now, so it's great for us.’ ‘I think the key on those aspects is to have a regular conversation with Lauren. As you can see, when she's fit and available, she's one of the best in the world. ‘For us it's really important to get some feedback on how she feels because I think she knows her body, but also for us with the competence we have in the staff to make sure we make together the right plan for her. ‘It's making sure in terms of the load going into the game, she gets the right thing, because also we are in a team where all the aspects of the game plan and the game model are really demanding, with the ball, without the ball. ‘So we just make sure we do what is appropriate for her body, and it's a lot of conversations. We almost have a conversation with her every day and that's really important for us to get the plan right.' ‘I think it was really important. I think in every player’s journey it is important sometimes to go on loan and to play minutes in a different environment. Things are really different sometimes when you are in a different club, in a different environment. ‘Sometimes when you can be a player who is a leader but maybe not the main leader in a squad like the Chelsea squad, you can suddenly become the main leader in a different team. So I think for her, being a main leader in that environment was crucial. ‘The fact she could play many minutes for them was also crucial for her development, but also for her confidence. Coming back to us, it was also making sure we were giving her the opportunity to get these minutes and now to be in a place where she can perform on a consistent basis. ‘Now she just has the opportunity to play in most of the games, performing really well, and I think having that loan at Crystal Palace was probably really beneficial for her to be where she is right now.’
news.body_zh: 周日，我们的女足超级联赛对阵水晶宫之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是蓝军主教练所说的关键谈话要点。这是女足超级联赛连续第四场比赛，本周日蓝军将迎来一场伦敦德比，我们将客场挑战水晶宫，并在这场比赛中取得五连胜。邦帕斯特证实，除了正在从小腿伤势中恢复的娜奥米·吉尔玛之外，球队的每一位成员都在争夺参加对阵老鹰队的比赛，其中包括潜在的首次亮相和金球奖提名的松久保真中。以下是我们主教练周四赛前新闻发布会上的其余关键谈话要点。 “我认为我们需要保持信心。现在我们是一支在球场上充满信心的球队。 “在防守方面，可能在周日，我们没有足够的时间在比赛模型方面提醒大家，我们希望在防守阶段的各个方面实现什么目标。托特纳姆热刺队的比赛很快就扭转了局面，但我们与球员们进行了良好的评价。 “我认为，在控球时，我们正在承担这样一个事实：我们在现在进行的每场比赛中都创造了很多机会，而且我们在禁区内也表现得冷静而无情。 “所以我们需要将这些积极的一面带到周日的比赛中。”“朱利亚是一位年轻、有天赋的球员。她在夏天加入了我们。我想现在你没有机会和我们一起经常见到她。这再次意味着，现在我有很多可用的球员，而且球队的竞争也很激烈。 “我很高兴朱莉娅加入我们。我认为有时对于年轻球员来说，需要一段时间才能融入球队并获得这些上场时间并成为我们更重要的球员，但我对朱利亚的心态感到非常满意。 “我认为无论在场上还是场下，她都是一个伟大的人，伟大的球员。当她在球场上时，她会非常努力。我对她的心态和心态非常满意。她总是想努力工作，她总是想进步，她总是热衷于做更多事情，我认为，加入我们，她现在处于一个很好的位置。 “我希望她能够得到一些时间，一些曝光。她打了一些分钟，但可能没有达到她想要的水平。但我有信心，因为她有正确的心态，并且她正在以正确的心态工作。 “所以我知道这些机会将会到来。我知道她会准备好抓住机会并展示她的能力以及她作为球员的素质。 “艾莉的表现非常出色。她的左脚攻入了两个进球，这很不寻常。所以现在她的表现非常好，能够以我们想要的团队方式影响比赛。 “无论控球还是控球，她都非常重要，能够在走廊里重复努力。我认为她在控球方面带来了很多，她总是有这种前进的心态和心态。 “她的速度很快，在技术方面进步很大。她现在能够送出非常好的传中，而且还能在禁区内冷静地进球。 “我不确定她能产生比她现在所做的更大的影响，所以这对我们来说很好。”“我认为这些方面的关键是与劳伦进行定期对话。正如你所看到的，当她身体健康且有空时，她是世界上最好的球员之一。 “对我们来说，获得有关她感受的反馈非常重要，因为我认为她了解自己的身体，但对我们来说，我们员工的能力也足以确保我们共同为她制定正确的计划。” “这确保了在比赛的负荷方面，她得到了正确的东西，因为我们所在的球队对比赛计划和比赛模式的各个方面都要求很高，无论是有球还是无球。 “所以我们只是确保做适合她身体的事情，这需要进行很多对话。我们几乎每天都会与她交谈，这对于我们制定正确的计划非常重要。” “我认为这非常重要。我认为在每个球员的旅程中，有时被租借并在不同的环境中踢球是很重要的。有时，当你在不同的俱乐部、不同的环境中时，情况确实会有所不同。 “有时候，当你可以成为一名领导者，但也许不是切尔西队这样的球队的主要领导者时，你可能会突然成为另一支球队的主要领导者。所以我认为对她来说，在那种环境下成为主要领导者至关重要。 “事实上，她可以为他们踢很多分钟，这对她的发展和自信也至关重要。回到我们身上，这也是为了确保我们给她机会获得这些上场时间，并且现在让她能够持续表现。 “现在她有机会参加大部分比赛，表现非常好，我认为租借到水晶宫可能对她现在所处的位置非常有利。”

news.title: Sonia Bompastor delivers Chelsea team news ahead of Crystal Palace
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在水晶宫赛前发布切尔西队新闻
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor provided the latest on Naomi Girma’s absence and hinted at a potential Chelsea Women debut for Manaka Matsukubo, as well as further involvement for returning captain Erin Cuthbert. The Blues face a yet another London derby in the Women’s Super League on Sunday, this time against newly promoted Crystal Palace. We are on a run of five consecutive wins in that competition, the last three of which have all been against sides from the capital – Tottenham Hotspur, West Ham United and Arsenal. Girma and summer signing Matsukubo both missed those victories due to injury and there was mixed news when Bompastor gave an update on their chances of featuring this weekend in her pre-match press conference on Thursday. ‘I didn't have much information on Naomi before,’ said our head coach. ‘I gave the earlier information before the international break, but actually Naomi is now dealing with a calf injury. ‘I think it will take a few weeks for her to get back, so for now she's just rehabbing. She's in a good place rehabbing and doing the things she has to do and to focus on. ‘We'll see, but I don't have any timeframe for now. I think otherwise I have the full squad available for the game on Sunday. ‘We had a few players who were involved in the Under-18 game and Manaka is also a player who could be in contention for the game on Sunday.’ One player who has already returned to action is Blues skipper Cuthbert, who came off the bench in the 6-2 win over Spurs at Stamford Bridge to make her first appearance since officially inheriting the captain’s armband for this season. For Bompastor, it seems the Scottish midfielder’s importance to the team cannot be overstated. ‘Erin is our captain, she's important on and off the pitch,’ Sonia explained. ‘I think she brings a lot of energy. I think the quality she has as a player in and out of possession, it's good news she's back with us. ‘In this block we will have to build her up to be able to start a game and to perform for 90 minutes, but we are having a lot of conversations with her. I think getting back to the team, playing 30 minutes in this league, is already a good step. ‘We have a plan for her all through this next block, we'll see what happens, but she's performing at a good level and in training this morning she was again good. I think she will help the team to get good results and to perform.’
news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托提供了娜奥米·吉尔玛缺席的最新消息，并暗示松久保真中可能会在切尔西女足首次亮相，而回归的队长艾琳·库斯伯特也将进一步参与其中。周日，蓝军将在女超联赛中迎来另一场伦敦德比，对手是升班马水晶宫。我们在那场比赛中取得了五连胜，其中最后三场比赛都是对阵来自首都的球队——托特纳姆热刺队、西汉姆联队和阿森纳队。吉尔马和夏季新援松久保都因伤错过了这些胜利，而当邦帕斯特在周四的赛前新闻发布会上更新了他们本周末出场的机会时，消息好坏参半。 “我之前没有太多关于娜奥米的信息，”我们的主教练说。 “我在国际比赛日之前就提供了较早的信息，但实际上内奥米现在正在处理小腿受伤的问题。 “我认为她需要几周的时间才能康复，所以目前她只是在康复。她处于一个很好的状态，正在康复并做她必须做和专注的事情。 “我们拭目以待，但我现在没有任何时间表。我想否则我的全队都可以参加周日的比赛。 “我们有几名球员参加了U-18比赛，马纳卡也是可能参加周日比赛的球员。”蓝军队长库斯伯特是已经回归赛场的球员之一，她在斯坦福桥6-2战胜热刺的比赛中替补出场，这是她正式继承本赛季队长袖标以来的首次出场。对于邦帕斯托尔来说，这位苏格兰中场球员对球队的重要性怎么强调都不为过。 “艾琳是我们的队长，她在球场内外都很重要，”索尼娅解释道。 “我认为她带来了很多能量。我认为她作为一名控球球员和控球球员的能力，她回到我们身边是个好消息。 “在这个区块中，我们必须让她能够开始一场比赛并表演 90 分钟，但我们正在与她进行很多对话。我认为回到球队，在联赛中出场30分钟，已经是很好的一步了。 “我们为她在下一个街区制定了计划，我们会看看会发生什么，但她的表现很好，在今天早上的训练中她再次表现出色。我认为她会帮助球队取得好成绩并表现出色。”
