news.title: Matthew Harding remembered: His life, death and legacy at Chelsea
news.title_zh: 马修·哈丁铭记：他的生、死和在切尔西留下的遗产
news.body_en: On the 30th anniversary of Matthew Harding’s passing, we use oral histories to recall the life, death, and legacy of our former supporter, benefactor and vice-chairman, who was tragically killed in October 1996. ‘The pleasure and the pain - Chelsea are both those things to me. It's hard to explain, but like any great love, I don't question it or feel tempted to stray. I just know that Chelsea and I were meant for each other.’ Matthew Harding's words will resonate with any Blues fan, indeed any football fan. The pleasure and the pain – it is what makes the sport we all love such a special one. Harding's support for the Blues began in the early 1960s when his father, who had been based in the Chelsea Barracks during the Second World War and had grown an interest in the football team playing nearby, took him to Stamford Bridge for the first time. He was nine years old, and they used to watch from the stilted former North Stand. Many years later, Matthew would have children of his own. His daughter Hannah is now, like her three siblings, Joel, Luke, and Patrick, a season ticket holder in the stand named after her dad. She explains how his passion bloomed. Hannah: ‘When he was at boarding school, he was really, really into football, really, really into Chelsea. It became a bit of an obsession, and that's what he concentrated on. I suppose when you're at boarding school you've got a lot of time on your own, and it sort of went from there, really. But he was always quite obsessive with things, so if he was in something, he was properly into it.’ Harding's support for the club continued as he grew older, made a fortune in London's reinsurance markets, and got married and had children. Before long, his daughter Hannah and three sons were accompanying him to matches. Joel was the youngest. Joel: ‘He lived and breathed Chelsea, so it was infectious, really. You had no choice. We were going home in a way, watching Chelsea, and it became our lives, really. He was just fun. It was about enjoying life, really, for him. Football was all about the day out.’ Hannah: ‘He was absolutely obsessed with Kerry Dixon. To the point he went to watch an England game once at the old Brighton Stadium, the Goldstone, because it said Dixon was playing. When we got there, it was Lee Dixon! And he wasn't interested in England, and there were no other Chelsea players playing for England, so we just stood there and then went home again.’ In the late '80s and early '90s, when Harding started regularly taking his children and traveling to away games, it was the future of Stamford Bridge rather than relegation to England's second tier that most concerned the club's hierarchy and supporters. Earlier in the '80s, chairman Ken Bates had turned the club around from the brink of bankruptcy and helped John Neal's exciting side get promoted back to the top flight in 1984. Now he was in the midst of a draining, decade-long battle against property developers and new ground owners, Marler Estates, who threatened to replace Stamford Bridge with luxury flats. Thankfully, a property market crash contributed to the collapse of the company that had taken on the Stamford Bridge lease. RBS took it over, and so Bates had more time to raise capital to buy the ground. Chelsea Pitch Owners were set up to protect the victory, but transforming the ground into an all-seater venue would require substantial funds. Bates placed an advert in the Financial Times inviting investment, and Harding responded. ‘I'm told you think you're richer than I am, and I thought I'd better ring you to find out,’ Bates famously opened with when they spoke for the first time in September '93. Hannah: ‘He never acted like he was wealthy. If you met him, you would never know that he had this wealth behind him. We weren’t exposed to it.’ Harding was worth £125 million. Few people in the country were wealthier. He more or less immediately invested £5 million in the club, and that, together with a £2 million football trust grant, kickstarted the redevelopment of Stamford Bridge into the 40,000-capacity all-seater venue we know today. Harding was also made a director and welcomed onto the Chelsea Village Board. Joel: ‘It just changed overnight, really. We went from just coming to games, getting the train up, going to the Imperial beforehand, walking into the stadium, just as a normal fan, and then overnight, people wanted to talk to him. They wanted to come up and shake his hand and ask him about Chelsea and get in a conversation with him.’ Hannah: ‘He'd talk a lot, so he'd end up sat there where he talked to everyone and anyone who talked to him. For us, we’d gone up in the East Stand and we got really into coming to Chelsea. And then when he put the money in, suddenly we could get a bit behind the scenes. We used to go in the players' lounge behind the East Stand, or we'd get to go to an away game. ‘I remember one away game, I went to QPR and we were in the director's box. I've got pictures of me and Vinnie Jones and Graham Le Saux and Kerry Dixon, and it became a bit surreal, because you'd been used to being the normal fan, and then suddenly you’re like, “Oh my God.”’ Luke Harding vividly recalls a unique experience he and his brothers got to enjoy. Luke: ‘One memory I've got after a game one Saturday, me, Joel, and Patrick snuck out onto the pitch and there was a load of footballs lying around. It was back when the Shed End had a temporary stand. Joel jumped into goal and we started having a kickabout and shooting into the goal. It one of the best memories of my life. ‘All of a sudden, the groundsman came out and started shouting at us! "What's going on? What are you doing over there?" We didn't know what to say! "Oh, I think Dad said it would be all right”. He went off to go find our Dad and it was all right in the end.’ For other Chelsea fans, Harding's emergence was exciting, as Trevor Nelson and, first, club historian Rick Glanvill remember. Rick Glanvill: ‘As supporters, you saw this super fan who thought, "I've made more money than I could ever dream of. Why wouldn't I try and help my team? If they need money to build a stand, the North Stand, as it was, now the Matthew Harding Stand, why wouldn't I give them that money so they can build it? If they want to get a player, why wouldn't I make that money available?"’ Trevor Nelson: ‘We just saw this guy as our savour. Matthew Harding was a wealthy guy, a mad Chelsea fan. Ken Bates had been the governor for so long, he'd done a great job for Chelsea, controversial, but he kept the club afloat. But this guy was the injection we needed.’ Glanvill: ‘There was a sense that Matthew Harding was the everyman that had become a millionaire, and that we would all do that if we won the lottery or whatever. You know, you might try and buy a left back or something like that for your club. He could do that for real.’ Harding's investment was not unconditional. He wanted details on what was going on behind the scenes, and he didn't want his influence to be limited merely to the club's bricks and mortar. He felt he could play a part in helping freshen things up on the pitch, too. The arrival of Glenn Hoddle as player-manager in the summer of '93, shortly before Harding got directly involved with the club, certainly helped in that respect, even if, as Hoddle recounts, there was plenty of work to do. Glenn Hoddle: ‘When I first came here, the club was in a really poor state. It really was. I've got to say it. I came from Swindon, and they had better facilities than we had at Chelsea. It was as simple as that. There was no office at the training ground, no phone, let alone an office for the manager. It was ridiculous, it really was. ‘It was quite humorous at times, having a BT phone to make a call to Ron Atkinson with 50 pence that would drop through in front of all the apprentices putting the kit in. That was what Chelsea was at that time. I was doing a deal for Andy Townsend for over £2 million with a 50 pence coin that dropped in the BT box and came out, and I had to keep putting it back in. ‘That was when I said, ‘Look, something's got to happen here. I've got to change the mentality of the club.’ He could see that the club needed finances, that the squad needed some help. He wasn't going to do it drastically overnight, but he had a plan. ‘I saw him just as a real fan, as a real supporter. Everyone will say that. And that's what he was. When I first met him, I realised the enthusiasm that he had for Chelsea, but it was through the eyes of a fan, always, not as an investor or looking to be anything else. He had a real passion for Chelsea. ‘I loved working with him, I've got to say. It was really good fun to be around him. Very comical guy, made you laugh, but he had this drive about him. He was a successful businessman, but he had this real passion and drive to put Chelsea in another level. When we sat down when I first met him, you could see his ambitions were to keep himself as a fan, but to get himself in at the board level to try and take Chelsea up to the levels where he wanted them to go. He could see where they could go. ‘I think he felt me coming to the club at that time, I had those ambitions to take the club up to another level. They sort of matched each other, and that was why we probably gelled and got on very well. ‘There were times when I'd have my afternoon where I'd study the opponents or talk about the team, and then Matthew would give me a phone call out of the blue. "Glenn, I'd like you to come down to London and we'll have lunch." I said, "I can't, Matthew. I've got plans this afternoon." "Don't worry about it," he would say. "I want to talk about the vision I've got for Chelsea going forward." ‘In the end, I would accept and see him there at 1 o’clock. He’d have had a bottle of wine by then. We started having so-called lunch, and he said, "Come and have a drink." I said, "No, I'm driving. I can't have a drink." ‘So I sat there and I listened to his vision, and when he starts going, you could see the passion coming out of him. It was lovely. We had some real laughs, and it was very humorous. And the plans he was coming out, the money that he wanted to put in, the squad, you know, what players are we going to buy? And this was all over the so-called lunch. I don't know if we ate any food, we just had a good conversation.’ Harding never forgot his roots. The following quote, his words, epitomised his beliefs: ‘I think that football clubs have got to run themselves as businesses on the one hand, but never forgetting, of course, the soul and the spirit of the football club and how much it means to the respective supporters.’ That attitude was why he was viewed so favourably, not only by Chelsea supporters, but by football fans all over the country. Glanvill: ‘He became a public figure well known to not just Chelsea fans, but fans all around the country. You would talk to people in pubs, and they would all go, "God, I wish we had a Matthew Harding."’ The players, too, grew to like the new director, including Frank Sinclair and Steve Clarke. Clarke: ‘I knew him quite well. We spent a little bit of time in each other's company. He was a good man, a great catalyst for the club at that time. At the time when Matthew came in, he was fresh. He was enthusiastic.’ Sinclair: ‘I had a decent friendship with him. He always stopped to talk to me and loved football, loved chatting about it, loved being around the players and sampling it that way. You had that feeling that he just wished he was a player. You took that on board and tried to make him as happy as possible because you appreciated what he was trying to do at the football club.’ Harding, like Bates, wasn’t afraid to stick up for Hoddle when things got off to a bad start under his management. Hoddle: ‘I had a hard time when I first came, in the first six months. We were second from bottom, and we'd just been beaten at Southampton. We were playing Newcastle. It was back in the day when you played two games in two days, and they were top of the league. Kevin Keegan was manager, and we had them at home. ‘I remember coming out at the Dell, the old Dell, and there were a few fans giving me real stick, especially as an ex-Tottenham player. They were, in a different way, nicely saying, "Why don't you go back to Tottenham?" You can imagine. ‘And I remember Matthew jumping off the bus. He saw it all happening, and he laid into them. He said what he had to say. I always remember that. And that was the balance between him and Ken, actually. Ken and I got a phone call that night in the hotel. He was on a cruise; he always used to go away. He phoned me from his cruise, somewhere in the Med or Barbados or wherever, to reassure me. "Don't worry about your job. Let's get on with it. A couple of results will turn it around." ‘And then you had Matthew confronting them as we're getting on the coach. So I had the support of both of the key people at the club, which was really good for me at the time. We came back here and we scrapped a 1-0 victory. We held on in the end because Newcastle were top of the league, flying, playing some great football, and that was the turn of it for us. We got ourselves back up the league and ended up going to the cup final that year.’ A season that had begun with Hoddle and Harding's arrival on the scene ended with a trip to Wembley, our first for a major final in a generation. Though the day out was spoiled by four unanswered Manchester United goals, the signs pointed to Chelsea Football Club being on the rise again. But more needed to be done. Hoddle: ‘The main thing is what happens out there in 90 minutes of football on matchday, and that is when you rely on your players, the quality of your players, and the depth of the squad that you've got. Our depth was very sparse, very slim. ‘Matthew saw that. He worked hard on Ken as well to try and make him see it as well and make the ambitions a lot higher and the standard a lot higher and the demands. We put demands on the players like they've never been put on here before. And slowly but surely, you could see it coming around on the training ground, and the stadium, too.’ The new North Stand opened in November 1994, and Harding relocated his and his children's season tickets there from their previous spot in the East Upper. He still socialised with friends and family in the pub before and after games, normally in the Imperial on the Kings Road, but he would change into a suit and tie before kick-off and watch the action unfold from the director's box. All the while, the friction between Bates and Harding was increasing. The pair fell out to such an extent Harding was banned from the directors' box. Hoddle and Colin Hutchinson, the longstanding chief executive, found themselves between the two. Hoddle: ‘I was in the middle of that. Because Matthew was probably younger and closer to my age, I think Ken thought I was in his camp but no, I was in no-one's camp. I was the manager of the club, and it was difficult at times to be caught in the middle, but at the end of the day, I had to get my head down and think about the football side and get that right. I had to detach myself from what was happening at board level. Colin Hutchinson was good on that one.’ Hutchinson: ‘It was a very difficult time, and playing piggy in the middle was very, very draining. I did an article in the programme which gave the virtues of both sides and appealed to them to come together. But right until the end, the animosity was there, there was jealousy, there was envy, everything was thrown in there.’ Later, when the club was floated on the stock exchange in April '96, a détente between the pair was achieved. Loans were repaid, and Harding was named vice chairman after buying nine million shares ahead of the 96/97 season, Ruud Gullit’s first as player-manager. Harding would never see the campaign's glorious conclusion. He and three friends, John Baldy, Tony Burridge, and Ray Dean, as well as pilot Michael Goss, were traveling back from the Blues’ League Cup third-round defeat at Bolton when their helicopter came down shortly before 11pm. A match programme found by firefighters at the scene was the first clue the victims were football fans. The coaching staff and players were on the bus back to London when a reporter called at 1am with the news there were fears Matthew Harding was on board. Before 3am, moves were in place to get Harding's body identified. The tragic news was made public at 8am. Immediately, fans – and not just those of a Chelsea persuasion – gathered at Stamford Bridge, laying flowers, shirts, pictures, scarves, mementos, and messages of love and respect. Chelsea held a board meeting and agreed to name the North Stand the Matthew Harding Stand. Training was called off, as was a reserve game scheduled to be played that day. The Premiership agreed to a minute's silence at all games that weekend, including Chelsea's. The home fixture with Tottenham, three days later, would take place. A mixture of disbelief and desolation engulfed the club as everyone mourned Harding's death at the age of just 42. Tributes poured in from far and wide: Newcastle manager Kevin Keegan, Graham Kelly at the FA, Real Madrid's general manager, UEFA, the mayor of Hammersmith and Fulham, the Tate Gallery, Peter Osgood. The list goes on. So did the football. Chelsea had a game to prepare for, and Eddie Newton, one of Harding's favourite ever players, brings to mind how he felt that week. Newton: ‘I remember hearing it on the news that apparently his helicopter had crashed. It didn't really sink in because you're still tired from the game. Then the next day, it obviously came out in its entirety. It took everybody aback. We knew that he was a big supporter of the club. Not only that, he was very involved in the club as someone that you meet. I didn't know him totally well, but when you spoke with him, he seemed a genuine guy. ‘He seemed a guy that really wanted the club to go up, and he wanted to be part of that, to push it in the right direction. In life there's always going to be tragedy, unfortunately, but as a professional, you have to keep going. You want the show to go on and people to do well. That's all you try to do, train properly, and be respectful around the circumstances of what was going on, and that's all we could do.’ Frank Sinclair and Steve Clarke also had to come to terms with what had happened. Clarke: ‘For the next few days, it was difficult to train properly, to work properly, but as professionals, we knew we had to go out and do as well as we could and try and get a result that would be a fitting tribute to Matthew's memory. Fortunately, we were able to do that, but it was a difficult time.’ Sinclair: ‘Everybody had an association with him so it was a tragic time at the football club when he passed away in that accident, and let’s not forget the other people that were on that helicopter as well. ‘You know, if anything, it grew us stronger together. How it affected us, I think it made us stronger as a group, and we went on to do great things that season.’ By the time the Tottenham game came around, the areas outside the ground resembled a shrine to Harding. Before kick-off, captain Dennis Wise and two of the other longest-serving players, Kevin Hitchcock and Steve Clarke, carried a large wreath onto the pitch and laid it in front of the newly renamed stand. It simply read: Matthew, RIP. A pint of Guinness, Harding's tipple of choice, was symbolically placed on the centre circle. The ground fell silent, with the Chelsea players stood holding hands, facing the Matthew Harding Stand. Barry Davies' introduction for that evening's featured game on Match of the Day summed up the sentiment. ‘Myriad thoughts through a minute of silence as Chelsea pay tribute to the man in the boardroom, the millionaire financier from the Shed, a charismatic football lad. As a Chelsea supporter for 34 of his almost 43 years, the visit to Spurs would have been a highlight of the season. After the tragedy which has left five families bereaved, it serves now as a commemoration and a thank you for what Matthew Harding brought to Chelsea Football Club.’ The match itself was dominated by the boys in blue. Gullit, starting his first league game of the season, opened the scoring. And though Tottenham's Chris Armstrong equalized before half-time, goals after the break from David Lee, a penalty, and Roberto Di Matteo, ensured a deserved and emotional home win. Manager and captain delivered their verdict afterwards. Gullit: ‘The team responded as they wanted to give something back. I was more happy about the winning for him than the winning for Chelsea or for myself. After the match, we had a team talk, and we all wanted to dedicate this victory to Matthew Harding.’ Wise: ‘We just wanted to win the game. It was just a tribute to Matthew from us to show a lot more passion and heart. We just wanted to win for the man. There’s not much I can say, I just feel for his family, and you don't know what to say, really. You just feel for them. We’ve just got to win something now, simple as that. We got to go out and make his dream come true.’ Gullit: ‘We have Matthew Harding always in our hearts. I'm not talking about only the players, but also the fans, the staff, people who work here. He will be with us forever.’ Hutchinson: ‘As Alan Sugar said to me after the match, they never had a chance. The crowd just carried the team through to win 3-1.’ Harding's funeral was held a few days later in Ditchling, Sussex. Representing Chelsea were Bates, Gullit, and Hoddle. Hoddle: ‘It was a dreadful funeral to go to. It really was. We should never have been going to that funeral at his age and the enthusiasm he had for life. It was very sad.’ Harding's great friend, Francis Maude, remembered him in one of the addresses given that day. This was how his heartfelt tribute concluded: ‘Never look back, Matthew used to say. But we will look back with love and thanks to an extraordinary man. And when we grieve for his going, as we mourn his loss, let's remember him as he was and smile through the tears.’ Harding's legacy was felt long after his death. His financial investment, somewhere in the region of £26.5 million, was important in elevating Chelsea to the next level on and off the pitch. It was something Bates acknowledged in public. Bates: ‘Matthew's death doesn't and will not affect our future plans. Such was his devotion to the club that he ensured that his promised financial commitment was totally in place, which is evidenced by the southern complex [at the Shed End], which you can see rising as we speak. It's the next phase of achieving his and indeed all Chelsea fans' dream of having a world-class team and a world-class stadium.’ A little over a year before his death, Harding was part of what would become known as the Marriott Accord, the term given to the Chelsea board meeting held at the prosaic Marriott Hotel in Slough the day after the '95 Cup final. It was an unlikely setting for one of the most significant days in the club's history, when a decision was made by Bates, Harding, Hutchinson, and Hoddle to start investing significant amounts of money in the team. Gullit was the first big-name signing. Hoddle: ‘Matthew got as excited as anyone as a fan. He said, “I’m pinching myself, Glenn. Have we got really good Ruud Gullit?!” Yes!’ The touchpaper had been lit. Mark Hughes was the next star to arrive, followed mid-season by Dan Petrescu, and then the trio of internationals who joined in the summer of '96: Gianluca Vialli, Roberto Di Matteo and Frank Leboeuf. Harding's money had proven pivotal in helping transform Chelsea into a club that would soon regularly be challenging for silverware. Joel: ‘It was a very exciting time. He died shortly after. And that's when we started the success, when we had the FA Cup with Middlesbrough, and from there, we won trophy after trophy. He never really got to see that side of Chelsea, which I think was a shame.’ Glanvill: ‘It was such a shock. There was a sense of truncated fulfilment that with Ruud Gullit in charge, with Matthew Harding investing and being a figurehead for the support, you felt anything was possible.’ Martin Tyler: ‘A Chelsea man, awful thing to happen. The fact that it's still remembered today tells you how much it meant to the followers of Chelsea. I didn't know him personally, but I knew exactly what he stood for. I knew he was Chelsea to the core. It was just a dreadful episode in the history of Chelsea. ‘Sometimes that just binds people together within the dressing room, within the boardroom, and certainly around the ground. You would never want it to happen, but if tragedy does fall, sometimes to the memory of the person who we've lost, it's a wonderful thing. He can't be here to appreciate it, but what would have accrued from that, he would be thrilled with in the sense of the love and the remembrance. It would have brought everybody onto the same page. ‘And the fact that there was a trophy at the end, I know his name was mentioned a lot in the build-up and in the ‘let's do it for Matthew and the family’, and it would have given them some comfort at a terrible time.’ As the commentator Martin Tyler alludes to, the sense of tremendous unity at the club that season played its part in propelling the Blues to FA Cup glory. The players, like Steve Clarke, felt its force. Clarke: ‘It was a great stimulus for the club. Matthew was a big part of pushing the club forward. We're all very grateful to what he did for us and the help that he gave the club at that time.’ Hoddle: ‘I think he'll always be remembered. And it's fantastic that the stand is always going to make us remember him when you come to Stamford Bridge.’ We will be celebrating Matthew Harding's life and legacy at this weekend's game against Tottenham, with a special video shown on the big screens around 15 minutes before kick-off.
news.body_zh: 在马修·哈丁去世 30 周年之际，我们用口述历史来回忆我们的前支持者、捐助者和副主席的生平、死亡和遗产，他于 1996 年 10 月不幸遇害。这很难解释，但就像任何伟大的爱情一样，我不会质疑它，也不会想迷失方向。我只知道切尔西和我是天生一对。”马修·哈丁的话会引起任何蓝军球迷的共鸣，实际上是任何足球迷的共鸣。快乐和痛苦——正是这些让我们都热爱的这项运动变得如此特别。哈丁对蓝军的支持始于 1960 年代初，当时他的父亲在第二次世界大战期间驻扎在切尔西军营，对附近的足球队产生了兴趣，第一次带他来到斯坦福桥。他当时九岁，他们过去常在高跷的前北看台观看比赛。许多年后，马修有了自己的孩子。他的女儿汉娜现在和她的三个兄弟姐妹乔尔、卢克和帕特里克一样，是看台上以她父亲的名字命名的季票持有者。她解释了他的热情是如何绽放的。汉娜：“当他在寄宿学校时，他非常非常喜欢足球，非常非常喜欢切尔西。这变得有点痴迷，而这就是他所专注的。我想当你在寄宿学校的时候，你有很多自己的时间，而且从那里开始，真的。但他总是对事情非常着迷，所以如果他从事某件事，他就会完全投入其中。随着年龄的增长，哈丁对俱乐部的支持仍在继续，他在伦敦的再保险市场上赚了一大笔钱，并结婚生子。不久之后，他的女儿汉娜和三个儿子陪他去看比赛。乔尔是最小的。乔尔：“他生活在切尔西，呼吸着切尔西，所以这真的很有感染力。”你别无选择。我们以某种方式回家，观看切尔西比赛，这真的成了我们的生活。他只是很有趣。对他来说，这实际上是为了享受生活。足球就是为了出去玩。” 汉娜：“他非常迷恋克里·迪克森。以至于他有一次去老布莱顿金石体育场观看了英格兰队的比赛，因为上面说迪克森正在比赛。当我们到达那里时，那是李·迪克森！他对英格兰不感兴趣，而且没有其他切尔西球员为英格兰效力，所以我们就站在那里，然后又回家了。”在80年代末和90年代初，当哈丁开始定期带着孩子去客场比赛时，最关心的是斯坦福桥的未来，而不是降级到英格兰第二梯队，俱乐部的高层和支持者最关心。 80 年代初期，主席肯·贝茨 (Ken Bates) 将俱乐部从破产边缘扭转过来，并帮助约翰·尼尔 (John Neal) 令人兴奋的球队在 ​​1984 年重返顶级联赛。现在，他正处于与房地产开发商和新场地所有者马勒庄园 (Marler Estates) 长达十年的艰苦斗争中，马勒庄园威胁要用豪华公寓取代斯坦福桥。值得庆幸的是，房地产市场的崩溃导致了承接斯坦福桥租约的公司倒闭。苏格兰皇家银行接管了这块土地，因此贝茨有更多时间筹集资金购买土地。切尔西球场业主的成立是为了保护胜利，但将球场改造成全座位场地需要大量资金。贝茨在《金融时报》上刊登了一则邀请投资的广告，哈丁做出了回应。 “我听说你认为你比我更有钱，我想我最好给你打电话来了解一下，”贝茨在 93 年 9 月第一次交谈时这样说道。汉娜：“他从来没有表现得像个富有的人。如果你见过他，你永远不会知道他背后有这么多财富。我们没有接触过它。”哈丁的身价为 1.25 亿英镑。这个国家很少有人比他更富有。他立即或多或少地向俱乐部投资了 500 万英镑，再加上 200 万英镑的足球信托基金，启动了斯坦福桥球场的重建工作，将其改造成我们今天所知的可容纳 40,000 人的全座位球场。哈丁还被任命为董事，并欢迎加入切尔西村委员会。乔尔：“真的，一夜之间就发生了变化。”我们从只是来观看比赛、坐火车、提前去帝国球场、走进体育场，就像一个普通球迷一样，然后一夜之间，人们想和他交谈。 他们想上前与他握手，向他询问切尔西的情况，并与他交谈。”汉娜：“他会说很多话，所以他最终会坐在那里，与每个人以及任何与他交谈的人交谈。对我们来说，我们已经登上了东看台，我们真的很想来到切尔西。然后当他投入资金时，我们突然就可以进入幕后了。我们过去常常去东看台后面的球员休息室，否则我们就要去观看客场比赛。 “我记得有一场客场比赛，我去了女王公园巡游者队，我们坐在教练包厢里。我有我和维尼·琼斯、格雷厄姆·勒索克斯和克里·迪克森的照片，这变得有点超现实，因为你已经习惯了成为普通粉丝，然后突然你会想，“哦，我的上帝。”卢克·哈丁生动地回忆起他和他的兄弟们享受的独特经历。卢克：“我记得一个周六的比赛结束后，我、乔尔和帕特里克偷偷溜到球场上，周围堆满了足球。那是在棚尾有一个临时摊位的时候。乔尔跳入球门，我们开始踢球并射门。这是我一生中最美好的回忆之一。 “突然，场地管理员走了出来，开始对我们大喊大叫！ “怎么了？你在那边做什么？”我们不知道该说什么！ “哦，我想爸爸说没关系”。他去找我们的父亲，最后一切都好起来。”对于其他切尔西球迷来说，哈丁的出现令人兴奋，正如特雷弗·尼尔森和俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔所记得的那样。里克·格兰维尔：“作为支持者，你会看到这位超级球迷想，‘我赚的钱比我梦想的要多。我为什么不尝试帮助我的球队呢？如果他们需要钱建造一个看台，北看台，现在的马修·哈丁看台，我为什么不给他们这笔钱，让他们可以建造它？如果他们想得到一名球员，我为什么不提供这笔钱呢？’” 特雷弗·尼尔森：“我们刚刚看到这个人作为我们的品味。马修·哈丁是个有钱人，也是个疯狂的切尔西球迷。肯·贝茨担任州长很长时间了，他为切尔西做了出色的工作，虽然颇受争议，但他让俱乐部得以维持下去。但这个人正是我们需要的注射剂。” 格兰维尔：“有一种感觉，马修·哈丁是成为百万富翁的普通人，如果我们中了彩票或其他什么，我们都会这样做。你知道，你可能会尝试为你的俱乐部购买一名左后卫或类似的球员。他可以真正做到这一点。”哈丁的投资并不是无条件的。他想要了解幕后发生的事情的细节，他不希望自己的影响力仅限于俱乐部的实体。他觉得自己也可以为球场上的新鲜事做出贡献。 93年夏天，就在哈丁直接参与俱乐部之前不久，格伦·霍德尔以球员兼教练的身份到来，这无疑在这方面有所帮助，尽管正如霍德尔所说，还有很多工作要做。格伦·霍德尔：“当我第一次来到这里时，俱乐部的状态非常糟糕。确实如此。我必须说一下。我来自斯温顿，他们的设施比我们在切尔西更好。就这么简单。训练场上没有办公室，没有电话，更没有经理办公室。这太荒谬了，确实如此。 “有时这很幽默，用英国电信电话给罗恩·阿特金森打电话，50 便士会在所有学徒面前投进去，把装备放进去。当时的切尔西就是这样。”我当时正在为安迪·汤森做一笔超过 200 万英镑的交易，一枚 50 便士的硬币掉进了 BT 盒子，然后又出来了，我不得不不断地把它放回去。我必须改变俱乐部的心态。”他可以看到俱乐部需要资金，球队需要一些帮助。他不打算在一夜之间彻底完成这件事，但他有一个计划。 “我把他视为一名真正的球迷、一名真正的支持者。每个人都会这么说。他就是这样。当我第一次见到他时，我就意识到他对切尔西的热情，但这总是通过球迷的眼睛，而不是作为投资者或寻求其他任何东西。他对切尔西充满热情。 “我不得不说，我喜欢和他一起工作。和他在一起真的很有趣。非常滑稽的家伙，让你开怀大笑，但他有这种动力。他是一位成功的商人，但他拥有真正的热情和动力，将切尔西提升到另一个水平。 当我第一次见到他时，当我们坐下来时，你可以看到他的野心是让自己继续作为球迷，但让自己进入董事会，尝试将切尔西提升到他希望他们达到的水平。他可以看到他们可以去哪里。 “我想他当时就感觉到我来到了俱乐部，我有雄心壮志将俱乐部提升到另一个水平。他们在某种程度上很匹配，这就是为什么我们很可能融为一体并且相处得很好。 “有时候，我会在下午研究对手或谈论球队，然后马修会突然给我打电话。 “格伦，我想让你来伦敦，我们一起吃午饭。”我说：“我不能，马修。我今天下午有计划。” “别担心，”他会说。 “我想谈谈我对切尔西未来的愿景。” “最后，我接受了，并在 1 点钟在那里见他。那时他已经喝了一瓶酒了。我们开始吃所谓的午餐，他说：“来喝一杯吧。”我说：“不行，我在开车，我不能喝酒。” “所以我坐在那里，聆听他的愿景，当他开始前进时，你可以看到他身上散发出的激情。很可爱。我们笑得很开心，而且非常幽默。他提出的计划，他想投入的资金，球队，你知道，我们要买什么球员？这就是所谓的午餐。我不知道我们是否吃了任何食物，我们只是聊得很开心。”哈丁从未忘记他的根。下面这句话概括了他的信念：“我认为足球俱乐部一方面必须像企业一样经营自己，但当然永远不要忘记足球俱乐部的灵魂和精神，以及它对各自的支持者的意义。”这种态度就是为什么他不仅受到切尔西支持者的青睐，而且受到全国各地球迷的青睐。格兰维尔：“他成为了公众人物，不仅为切尔西球迷所熟知，而且为全国各地的球迷所熟知。你会和酒吧里的人交谈，他们都会说，“上帝，我希望我们有一个马修·哈丁。”球员们也开始喜欢这位新导演，包括弗兰克·辛克莱和史蒂夫·克拉克。克拉克：“我很了解他。我们在彼此的陪伴下度过了一些时间。他是一个好人，是当时俱乐部的伟大催化剂。马修进来的时候，他精神焕发。他很热情。” 辛克莱：“我和他有很好的友谊。他总是停下来和我说话，他热爱足球，喜欢谈论足球，喜欢和球员在一起并以这种方式品味足球。你有一种感觉，他只是希望自己是一名球员。你接受了这一点，并试图让他尽可能开心，因为你欣赏他在足球俱乐部所做的事情。”哈丁和贝茨一样，当霍德尔在他的管理下开局不利时，他并不害怕为霍德尔挺身而出。霍德尔：“我刚来的头六个月过得很艰难。我们排名倒数第二，而且我们刚刚在南安普顿被击败。我们正在对阵纽卡斯尔。那是在两天内打两场比赛的日子，他们是联盟顶级的。凯文·基冈是主教练，我们把他们放在家里。 “我记得在戴尔球场，老戴尔球场，有一些球迷给了我真正的支持，尤其是作为一名前托特纳姆热刺球员。他们以不同的方式善意地说：“你为什么不回到托特纳姆热刺呢？”你可以想象。 “我记得马修跳下了公共汽车。他目睹了这一切的发生，并投入其中。他说了他必须说的话。我一直记得这一点。实际上，这就是他和肯之间的平衡。那天晚上，肯和我在酒店接到一个电话。他正在游轮上；他总是走开。他在地中海或巴巴多斯的某个地方的游轮上给我打电话，让我放心。 “别担心你的工作。我们继续吧。几个结果将会扭转局面。” “然后，当我们上车时，马修与他们对峙。所以我得到了俱乐部两位关键人物的支持，这对我来说真的很有好处。我们回到这里并以1-0的比分战胜了对手。我们最终坚持了下来，因为纽卡斯尔是联赛中的佼佼者，他们在飞翔，踢着精彩的足球，这就是轮到我们的时候了。 我们在联赛中重回正轨，并最终进入了当年的杯赛决赛。”以霍德尔和哈丁的到来开始的一个赛季以温布利之旅结束，这是我们这一代人第一次进入重要决赛。尽管曼联的四个进球破坏了这一天，但迹象表明切尔西足球俱乐部再次崛起。但还需要做更多的事情。霍德尔：“最重要的是比赛日 90 分钟的足球比赛中发生的事情，那就是当你依赖你的球员、你的球员的素质以及你所拥有的球队的深度时。我们的深度非常稀疏，非常狭窄。 ‘马修看到了。他也在肯身上下了不少功夫，试图让他也看到这一点，并让他的抱负更高、标准更高、要求更高。我们对球员提出了前所未有的要求。慢慢地，但可以肯定的是，你可以看到它在训练场和体育场上出现。”新的北看台于 1994 年 11 月开放，哈丁将他和孩子们的季票从以前在东上区的位置搬到了这里。比赛前后，他仍然在酒吧与朋友和家人进行社交活动，通常是在国王路的帝国酒店，但他会在开球前换上西装，打上领带，在导演包厢里观看比赛的展开。与此同时，贝茨和哈丁之间的摩擦不断增加。两人争吵到了如此程度，哈丁被禁止进入董事席。霍德尔和长期担任首席执行官的科林·哈钦森发现自己介于两者之间。霍德尔：“我正处于其中。因为马修可能更年轻，也更接近我的年龄，我想肯认为我属于他的阵营，但不，我不属于任何人的阵营。我是俱乐部的主教练，有时夹在中间很困难，但最终，我必须低下头，思考足球方面的问题，并把事情做好。我必须让自己脱离董事会层面发生的事情。科林·哈钦森（Colin Hutchinson）在这一点上做得很好。” 哈钦森：“那是一段非常困难的时期，在中间打小猪非常非常累。我在节目里写了一篇文章，介绍了双方的优点，呼吁他们走到一起。但直到最后，敌意一直存在，有嫉妒，有羡慕，一切都被扔在那里。”后来，当俱乐部于 96 年 4 月在证券交易所上市时，两人之间的关系得到了缓和。贷款得到偿还，哈丁在 96/97 赛季前购买了 900 万股股票后被任命为副主席，这是路德·古利特首次担任球员兼教练。哈丁永远不会看到竞选活动的辉煌结局。他和三个朋友约翰·鲍尔迪 (John Baldy)、托尼·伯里奇 (Tony Burridge) 和雷·迪恩 (Ray Dean) 以及飞行员迈克尔·戈斯 (Michael Goss) 在蓝军联赛杯第三轮输给博尔顿后返回途中，他们的直升机在晚上 11 点前不久坠落。消防队员在现场发现的一份比赛节目是受害者是足球迷的第一个线索。凌晨 1 点，当一名记者打电话告知教练组和球员们正在返回伦敦的巴士上时，他们担心马修·哈丁也在车上。凌晨 3 点之前，我们已采取行动对哈丁的尸体进行辨认。上午8点，这一悲惨消息被公开。立即，球迷们——不仅仅是切尔西球迷——聚集在斯坦福桥，献上鲜花、衬衫、照片、围巾、纪念品以及表达爱和尊重的信息。切尔西召开董事会会议，同意将北看台命名为马修·哈丁看台。训练被取消，原定于当天进行的预备队比赛也被取消。英超同意在那个周末的所有比赛中默哀一分钟，包括切尔西的比赛。三天后，将举行主场对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛。难以置信和悲伤的心情笼罩着俱乐部，每个人都在哀悼哈丁，年仅42岁。哈丁的去世从四面八方涌来：纽卡斯尔主教练凯文·基冈、英足总格雷厄姆·凯利、皇家马德里总经理、欧足联、哈默史密斯和富勒姆市长、泰特美术馆、彼得·奥斯古德。这样的例子还在继续。足球也是如此。切尔西有一场比赛需要准备，哈丁最喜欢的球员之一埃迪·牛顿回忆起了他那周的感受。牛顿：“我记得在新闻中听到过，显然他的直升机坠毁了。它并没有真正融入，因为你仍然对游戏感到厌倦。 然后第二天，它显然就完整地出来了。让所有人都大吃一惊。我们知道他是俱乐部的大力支持者。不仅如此，作为你遇到的人，他非常积极地参与俱乐部。我不太了解他，但当你和他交谈时，他看起来是一个真诚的人。 “他似乎是一个真正希望俱乐部进步的人，他想成为其中的一部分，将其推向正确的方向。不幸的是，生活中总会有悲剧，但作为专业人士，你必须继续前进。你希望节目能够继续下去，人们也能表现出色。这就是你要做的一切，正确训练，尊重正在发生的情况，这就是我们所能做的。”弗兰克·辛克莱和史蒂夫·克拉克也必须接受所发生的事情。克拉克：“在接下来的几天里，很难好好训练，好好工作，但作为职业球员，我们知道我们必须出去，尽我们所能，努力取得一个结果，以纪念马修。”幸运的是，我们能够做到这一点，但那是一段艰难的时期。” 辛克莱：“每个人都与他有联系，所以当他在那次事故中去世时，这对足球俱乐部来说是一个悲惨的时刻，我们不要忘记直升机上的其他人。 ‘你知道，如果说有什么不同的话，那就是它让我们在一起变得更加强大。它对我们的影响如何，我认为这让我们作为一个团队变得更加强大，我们在那个赛季继续做了伟大的事情。”到托特纳姆热刺比赛开始时，球场外的区域就像哈丁的圣地。开球前，队长丹尼斯·怀斯和另外两名效力时间最长的球员凯文·希区柯克和史蒂夫·克拉克将一个大花圈带到球场上，放在新命名的看台前。上面写着：马修，安息吧。哈丁选择的一品脱吉尼斯啤酒被象征性地放置在中心圆圈上。全场鸦雀无声，切尔西球员手拉着手，面向马修·哈丁看台。巴里·戴维斯（Barry Davies）对当晚《每日比赛》特色比赛的介绍总结了这种情绪。 “在默哀一分钟的过程中，切尔西向董事会里的那个人、来自棚屋的百万富翁金融家、一个有魅力的足球小伙子致敬，无数的想法。作为切尔西球迷近 43 年中的 34 年，对热刺的访问将成为本赛季的一大亮点。在这场造成五个家庭失去亲人的悲剧发生后，现在它是为了纪念和感谢马修·哈丁为切尔西足球俱乐部所做的一切。” 比赛本身由蓝衣男孩主导。古力特在本赛季的第一场联赛中首发，并首开纪录。尽管托特纳姆热刺队的克里斯·阿姆斯特朗在半场结束前扳平比分，但中场休息后大卫·李的点球和罗伯托·迪马特奥的进球确保了一场当之无愧的、激动人心的主场胜利。经理和队长随后做出了裁决。古力特：“球队做出了回应，因为他们想回馈一些东西。我对他的胜利比为切尔西或我自己的胜利更高兴。赛后，我们进行了一次团队谈话，我们都想将这场胜利献给马修·哈丁。” 怀斯：“我们只是想赢得比赛。这只是我们向马修致敬，表现出更多的热情和爱心。我们只是想为这个人赢得胜利。我无话可说，我只是为他的家人感到难过，但你真的不知道该说什么。你只是对他们有感觉。我们现在必须赢得一些东西，就这么简单。我们必须走出去，让他的梦想成真。” 古利特：“我们心中永远有马修·哈丁。我不仅谈论球员，还谈论球迷、工作人员和在这里工作的人们。他将永远和我们在一起。” 哈钦森：“正如艾伦·舒格赛后对我说的那样，他们从来没有机会。球迷们带领球队最终以 3-1 获胜。几天后，哈丁的葬礼在苏塞克斯的迪奇林举行。代表切尔西队的是贝茨、古力特和霍德尔。霍德尔：“这是一场可怕的葬礼。确实如此。以他的年纪和他对生活的热情，我们根本不应该去参加那个葬礼。哈丁的好朋友弗朗西斯·莫德在当天的一次演讲中回忆起他。这就是他衷心的敬意的结论：“永远不要回头，马太常说。”但我们会满怀爱意地回顾并感谢一位非凡的人。 当我们为他的离去而悲伤时，当我们哀悼他的去世时，让我们记住他的本来面目，并含着泪水微笑。”哈丁的遗产在他死后很久才被人们所感受到。他的财务投资约为 2650 万英镑，对于将切尔西在球场内外提升到一个新的水平非常重要。贝茨在公开场合承认了这一点。贝茨：“马修的去世不会也不会影响我们未来的计划。他对俱乐部的奉献如此之大，以至于他确保了他所承诺的财务承诺完全到位，南部综合体（位于谢德恩德）证明了这一点，在我们说话时你可以看到它正在崛起。这是实现他乃至所有切尔西球迷梦想的下一个阶段，即拥有一支世界级球队和世界级体育场。”在哈丁去世前一年多一点，哈丁是后来被称为“万豪协议”的一部分，这个术语指的是“95年杯决赛后第二天在斯劳普普通通的万豪酒店举行的切尔西董事会会议”。对于俱乐部历史上最重要的日子之一来说，这是一个不太可能的环境，贝茨、哈丁、哈钦森和霍德尔决定开始向球队投入大量资金。古力特是第一个签约的大牌球员。霍德尔：“马修和球迷一样兴奋。他说：“我在掐自己，格伦。我们有真正优秀的路德·古利特吗？！”是的！”触摸纸已经点亮了。马克·休斯 (Mark Hughes) 是下一位到来的明星，紧随其后的是赛季中期的丹·佩特雷斯库 (Dan Petrescu)，然后是 96 年夏天加入的三名国际球员：吉安卢卡·维亚利 (Gianluca Vialli)、罗伯托·迪马特奥 (Roberto Di Matteo) 和弗兰克·勒伯夫 (Frank Leboeuf)。事实证明，哈丁的资金对于帮助切尔西转变为一家很快就会经常挑战奖杯的俱乐部至关重要。乔尔：“那是一个非常激动人心的时刻。不久之后他就去世了。就在那时我们开始了成功，当我们与米德尔斯堡一起获得了足总杯冠军时，从那时起，我们赢得了一个又一个奖杯。他从来没有真正看到切尔西的这一面，我认为这是一种耻辱。” 格兰维尔：“这真是太令人震惊了。在路德·古利特的带领下，在马修·哈丁的投资和支持下，你会感到一切皆有可能。” 马丁·泰勒：“对于一个切尔西人来说，发生了可怕的事情。今天它仍然被人们铭记这一事实说明了它对切尔西球迷的意义有多大。我个人并不认识他，但我很清楚他代表什么。我知道他是彻头彻尾的切尔西人。这只是切尔西历史上的一个可怕的插曲。 “有时，这只是将更衣室、董事会、当然还有球场上的人们联系在一起。你永远不会希望它发生，但如果悲剧确实发生，有时是我们失去的人的记忆，那是一件美妙的事情。他不能在这里欣赏它，但由此产生的一切，他会因为爱和回忆而感到兴奋。它会让每个人都进入同一页面。 “事实上，最后获得了一座奖杯，我知道他的名字在准备过程中被多次提及，在‘让我们为马修和他的家人做这件事’中，这会给他们在这个可怕的时刻带来一些安慰。”正如评论员马丁·泰勒提到的那样，那个赛季俱乐部的巨大团结感在推动蓝军夺得足总杯荣耀方面发挥了重要作用。史蒂夫·克拉克等球员感受到了它的力量。克拉克：“这对俱乐部来说是一个巨大的刺激。马修是推动俱乐部前进的重要组成部分。我们都非常感谢他为我们所做的一切以及他当时为俱乐部提供的帮助。” 霍德尔：“我认为他会永远被记住。当你来到斯坦福桥时，看台总是能让我们记住他，这真是太棒了。”我们将在本周末对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中庆祝马修·哈丁的一生和遗产，开球前 15 分钟左右大屏幕上会播放一段特别视频。

news.title: Update for fans attending match versus Tottenham

news.body_en: Ahead of Saturday’s match at Stamford Bridge, we have information to share regarding  Live Facial Recognition being used by the Metropolitan Police in the local area as well as expectations and measures regarding fan behaviour. The Metropolitan Police Service (MPS) has informed the club that on Saturday, Live Facial Recognition (LFR) will be deployed during the policing operation for the Chelsea versus Tottenham fixture.  The deployment follows the established stakeholder engagement approach previously used for football-related LFR deployments.  The two locations will be Earl's Court and West Brompton and two LFR vans will be deployed across these locations before the game. Signage will be deployed outside the zone of recognition in line with MPS LFR policy. The watchlist will contain individuals subject to Football Banning Orders relating to either club, together with persons wanted or missing for serious offences and those sought on warrants issued by HMCTS. The derby against Tottenham Hotspur is always one of our most anticipated games of the season and we are expecting nothing less than a passionate and vibrant atmosphere as we take on big London rivals. We welcome the part our supporters play in getting behind the team as the players target three wins in a row and victory in the first home London derby of the season.  We would like to remind supporters of their responsibilities in keeping support positive and ensuring that Stamford Bridge is a welcoming environment for all.   Discriminatory actions or language such as antisemitic or sectarian chanting have no place anywhere in football or society, and Chelsea is a club that actively celebrates our diversity. There are measures in place and strong sanctions against offenders to tackle discriminatory, anti-social and criminal behaviour. This could include suspension from attending all Chelsea matches, as well as potential police action. If you witness any anti-social or discriminatory behaviour on matchday, please report it to us.  Click below to use our reporting form for home matchdays.  This link will be active and the form available for use from three hours prior to kick-off until one hour after the final whistle.  - Click to access the reporting form At other times, click here to make a report. You can also report it in real time by using our reporting number. During the match text 88777 or 07894 93 77 93, with the stand, row, seat number and description of the offender and incident. All Premier League matches from 17 to 25 October are dedicated to No Room For Racism, reinforcing a collective commitment to tackling all forms of discrimination and promoting diversity within football. With Saturday being our home match during this period, a film will be shown inside Stamford Bridge, celebrating diversity as one of the game's greatest strengths. It will also highlight the impact racism can have on players, their families and communities, and encourages fans to challenge and report discriminatory behaviour. The No Room For Racism message will be displayed throughout the stadium, and players will be taking the knee to show solidarity against discrimination and send a clear message that racism has no place in our game or wider society. Supporters are reminded that engineering work affecting the District Line, with Fulham Broadway Station closed on Saturday, may have an impact on journeys to and from the match. There are also closures on the Circle and Mildmay Lines. The full information with walking routes and a journey planner can be found here.

news.body_en: Chelsea Women travel to Sutton to face Crystal Palace on Sunday, fresh from a 6-2 win over Tottenham at Stamford Bridge last weekend. The newly-promoted side are our latest opponents in the Women's Super League as we currently sit second in the table with five wins and a draw from our opening six league matches of the campaign. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Crystal Palace against Chelsea Women, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Crystal Palace takes place on Sunday 25 October 2026 at the 360 Engage Stadium, with kick-off scheduled for 12 noon UK time. If you are unable to make the match on Sunday, then you can watch the action live on Sky Sports Mix and Sky Mix. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our Crystal Palace vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. We are unbeaten in all competitions this season, and have taken 16 points from a maximum of 18 in the WSL, winning each of our last five matches. The Eagles have taken six points from their first six games of the campaign with one win, three draws and two defeats since the opening day. Sonia Bompastor faced Crystal Palace in her first away match in charge of Chelsea in September 2024. A brace from Guro Reiten plus goals from Aggie Beever-Jones, Nathalie Bjorn, Lucy Bronze, Lauren James and Catarina Macario secured a 7-0 victory at Selhurst Park that day, and we followed that result with more success against the Eagles during that season. A solitary strike from James saw us defeat Palace in the Women's FA Cup quarter-final with a 1-0 win at Kingsmeadow, before they visited us again in league action in April and we recorded a 4-0 victory. That trio of wins helped us to an undefeated domestic Treble in 2024/25, while Palace were relegated at the end of that campaign.

news.title: Eden Hazard’s double Spurs masterclass remembered
news.title_zh: 埃登·阿扎尔的双热刺大师班被铭记
news.body_en: As Chelsea prepare to face Tottenham Hotspur on Saturday, we look back to when Eden Hazard inspired the Blues to a pair of huge results against our London rivals in the Premier League a decade ago. When Tottenham came to Stamford Bridge ten years ago they hadn’t taken three points in west London since 1990 – a record which would eventually stretch on until April 2018. It might seem hard to believe now, given Tottenham’s recent fortunes, but on both occasions when these two sides met in 2016, Chelsea were facing genuine title contenders. The first came near the end of the 2015/16 campaign, with Mauricio Pochettino leading Spurs’ title challenge and, not for the first time, Guus Hiddink on the Chelsea bench on a temporary basis, following Jose Mourinho’s departure. The mission for the visitors was clear, after losing ground to Leicester City at the top of the table – win or their title chances would be other. In the Blues’ corner, Hiddink tried to emphasise that this was just another game, worth no more than any other in the league. He was fooling nobody. Right from the first minute, the game was played at 100mph. It seemed too quick for some of the players to keep up, judging by the lateness of many of the tackles. One early such challenge by Kyle Walker on Pedro drew gasps around the stadium. They would not be the last we heard. Diego Costa and Jan Vertonghen in particular seemed to be on the verge of tearing each other’s shirts to shreds throughout. It was not hard to see why this game would become known as the Battle of the Bridge. It was Tottenham who handled that situation best initially, perhaps a consequence of having so much on the line, as Harry Kane and Son Heung-Min gave them a 2-0 lead. However, when Hazard – whose fitness was being managed carefully following a niggling injury – was introduced at half-time, it suddenly became a different game. Our star winger was a player of composure, not to be intimidated by rough treatment, which was no novelty to him. He received it every week, regardless of occasion or opponent. When Spurs cracked it was our defenders who did the damage, though. John Terry drew Tottenham’s attention with his run at a corner, allowing Cahill the space to bring the ball down near penalty spot and lash into the back of the net. With seven minutes left, Hazard decided it was about time to break north London hearts. Shrugging off those attempting to put him under pressure, the Belgian exchanged passes with John Mikel Obi and Diego Costa to travel from the halfway line to the penalty box, before guiding a finish into the top corner. That made the final score 2-2. Tottenham’s title hopes were dashed, the Foxes were champions of England. You’re welcome Leicester, it really was our pleasure! By the time Tottenham came back to Stamford Bridge in 2016/17, almost exactly 10 years ago, one of the Leicester players to benefit from that previous result was now lining up against them with Chelsea, after N’Golo Kante had moved to west London in the summer. When the teams walked out onto the Stamford Bridge pitch, Chelsea had been knocked off the top of the table by Liverpool earlier in the day. Spurs were four points behind in the standings, as the only remaining unbeaten team in the Premier League. It was the home team who were undoubtedly the form side, though. The Blues were on a run of six wins in a row, all with clean sheets, since Antonio Conte had famously changed to a back three at half-time against Arsenal. However, there was to be no clean sheet this time. After going 600 minutes without conceding a league goal, Christian Eriksen scored with just 11 minutes played of this game. That Chelsea team was picking up a momentum that would not be denied, though, and we were level on the brink of half-time. That came via a lovely goal by Pedro, who recently announced his retirement. The move started with clever passing between Kante and the defenders to escape Spurs’ press, then a splitting pass by Nemanja Matic to find Pedro on the edge of the box. The Spaniard spun and curled into the top corner brilliantly. Not long after the break, we struck again to underline which London side was the genuine title contender for 2016/17. Pedro was heavily involved again, stepping in to join Kante and Matic’s midfield press to win the ball and leave Tottenham exposed. Hazard and Diego Costa combined down the left and, when the rolled a pass across goal, Pedro’s clever run took the Tottenham defenders to the near post, leaving Victor Moses completely free to smash in from close range. In the space of a few months, both after Tottenham had taken a lead to give them a chance of ending their winless run at the Bridge, Chelsea had twice inflicted damaging results on our capital rivals, with the second also helping to launch us on our way to become runaway league leaders, and eventually Premier League champions. Two players involved in those games, Hazard and Terry, had an excellent derby record against Spurs throughout their Blues careers. They will both be facing their old enemies at the Bridge again when Chelsea Legends take on Tottenham on 27 March, with tickets on general sale here now. Before then, it is in the fully competitive derby day atmosphere of the Premier League and Stamford Bridge that Chelsea and Tottenham will lock horns next, when our rivals make the trip across the capital for a 5.30pm kick-off in west London this Saturday. news.body_zh: 当切尔西准备周六对阵托特纳姆热刺队时，我们回顾了十年前伊登·阿扎尔激励蓝军在英超联赛中对阵伦敦对手时取得的巨大成绩。十年前，当托特纳姆热刺来到斯坦福桥时，他们自 1990 年以来就没有在西伦敦拿到过 3 分，这一纪录最终将延续到 2018 年 4 月。考虑到托特纳姆热刺最近的命运，现在看来似乎很难相信，但当两支球队在 2016 年相遇时，切尔西都面对着真正的冠军争夺者。第一次是在2015/16赛季接近尾声时，毛里西奥·波切蒂诺带领热刺向冠军挑战，而在何塞·穆里尼奥离开后，古斯·希丁克也不是第一次临时坐在切尔西的替补席上。在输给积分榜榜首的莱斯特城之后，客队的使命很明确——要么获胜，要么夺冠的机会就另当别论了。在蓝军的角落里，希丁克试图强调这只是另一场比赛，其价值并不比联盟中的任何其他比赛高。他没有欺骗任何人。从第一分钟开始，比赛就以每小时 100 英里的速度进行。从许多铲球迟到来看，对于一些球员来说，速度似乎太快了，无法跟上。凯尔·沃克（Kyle Walker）早期对佩德罗（Pedro）的一次此类挑战引起了体育场周围的倒吸一口凉气。他们不会是我们最后听到的。尤其是迭戈·科斯塔和扬·维尔通亨，自始至终似乎都处于将对方的衬衫撕成碎片的边缘。不难理解为什么这场比赛被称为桥之战。托特纳姆热刺队一开始就处理得最好，也许是因为有太多的危险，哈里·凯恩和孙兴慜帮助他们2-0领先。然而，当阿扎尔在中场休息时上场时，比赛突然变成了一场不同的比赛。我们的明星边锋是一位冷静的球员，不会被粗暴的对待吓倒，这对他来说并不新鲜。他每周都会收到它，无论场合或对手如何。不过，当热刺破门时，造成伤害的是我们的后卫。约翰·特里在角球处的跑动吸引了托特纳姆热刺的注意，为卡希尔提供了空间，将球带入点球点附近，然后射入球网。比赛还剩七分钟时，阿扎尔认为是时候让北伦敦人心碎了。比利时人摆脱了那些试图给他施加压力的人，与约翰·米克尔·奥比和迭戈·科斯塔交换传球，从中线到禁区，然后将球射入上角。最终比分定为2-2。托特纳姆热刺队的冠军希望破灭了，狐狸队成为了英格兰的冠军。不客气，莱斯特，这真的是我们的荣幸！当托特纳姆热刺在2016/17赛季重返斯坦福桥时，几乎整整10年前，莱斯特城的一名受益于之前成绩的球员现在正在与切尔西对阵，因为恩戈洛·坎特在夏天搬到了西伦敦。当两支球队走上斯坦福桥球场时，切尔西在当天早些时候被利物浦从积分榜榜首的位置上淘汰了。热刺在积分榜上落后4分，是英超联赛中唯一一支保持不败的球队。不过，毫无疑问，主队的状态最好。自从安东尼奥·孔蒂在对阵阿森纳的半场比赛中换上三后卫后，蓝军已经取得了六连胜，并且全部保持零失球。然而，这一次没有零封。在连续 600 分钟联赛不失球后，克里斯蒂安·埃里克森在本场比赛仅用了 11 分钟就进球了。不过，切尔西队的势头不容否认，我们在半场结束时扳平了比分。这是佩德罗进球的结果，他最近宣布退役。这一举动首先是坎特和后卫之间巧妙的传球，以躲避热刺的压力，然后内马尼亚·马蒂奇的分球传球找到了禁区边缘的佩德罗。西班牙人出色地旋转并弧线射入球门上角。中场休息后不久，我们再次强调哪支伦敦球队才是2016/17赛季真正的冠军争夺者。佩德罗再次积极参与，加入坎特和马蒂奇的中场压迫，赢得球权，让托特纳姆热刺暴露在外。 阿扎尔和迭戈·科斯塔在左路联手，当球传过球门时，佩德罗巧妙的跑动将热刺后卫带到了近门柱，让维克托·摩西完全可以自由地近距离射门。在几个月的时间里，托特纳姆热刺队取得领先，让他们有机会结束在桥上的不胜纪录，切尔西队两次给我们的首都对手带来了破坏性的结果，第二次也帮助我们走上了成为失控的联赛领头羊的道路，并最终成为英超冠军。参与这些比赛的两名球员，阿扎尔和特里，在他们的蓝军生涯中，对阵热刺的德比战绩非常出色。当切尔西传奇队于 3 月 27 日迎战托特纳姆热刺队时，他们将再次在桥上面对他们的老对手，门票现已在这里公开发售。在此之前，在英超联赛和斯坦福桥的德比日气氛中，切尔西和托特纳姆热刺将在本周六下午 5 点 30 分穿过首都，在伦敦西部开赛。为下一个德比日做好准备，本周六我们将在斯坦福桥迎战伦敦对手托特纳姆热刺队。与切尔西俱乐部一起提升您的比赛日 - 独家 VIP 体验现已发售。

news.title: Mike Penders: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 迈克·彭德斯：我的足球第一次
news.body_en: We hear from Mike Penders, fresh from making his Premier League debut for Chelsea, about his earliest experiences of the game. The goalkeeper, who came on in our 2-0 win at Everton last weekend, answers our quickfire questions so Blues fans can get to know him better… What was the first football match you went to? That would be the Belgium national team in the King Baudouin Stadium when I was kid. What was the first football kit you owned? It was a Belgium shirt, the outfield one not the goalkeeper one! What was the first team you played for? Boorsem Sport, a local team where I live. They’re maybe not the first, but I would say goalkeeper coaches from Genk from the past: Paul Peeters, Gilbert Roex and Koen Witters. Who was your first team-mate who became a friend? That is my best friend, he is called Gerben. We played together when we were about eight years old. Who was your first professional game against? It was in the second division in Belgium. They were professional by then. It was for Genk’s second team against Waasland-Beveren. Who was your first goal against? I remember scoring once when I was very young! It was on the very small pitches and I was playing for Boorsem. It will stay in my mind forever! Can you remember the first time somebody recognised you in public? That was when I was at Genk, when I started to play some games there. I can remember it a little bit. What was your first emotion when you signed for Chelsea? It was amazing, of course. One of the biggest teams in the world. You don’t need a lot of persuasion to do that!
news.body_zh: 我们从刚刚为切尔西完成英超首秀的迈克·潘德斯讲述了他最早的比赛经历。这位上周末在我们 2-0 战胜埃弗顿的比赛中出场的门将回答了我们的快速提问，以便蓝军球迷能够更好地了解他……您去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？那是我小时候在博杜安国王体育场的比利时国家队。您拥有的第一套足球装备是什么？那是一件比利时球衣，是外场球衣，不是守门员球衣！你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？ Boorsem Sport，我居住的当地球队。他们也许不是第一批，但我想说的是过去来自亨克的守门员教练：保罗·皮特斯、吉尔伯特·罗克斯和科恩·维特斯。谁是你第一个成为朋友的队友？那是我最好的朋友，他叫格本。我们八岁左右的时候就一起玩耍。你的第一场职业比赛是对阵谁？那是在比利时乙级联赛。那时他们已经很专业了。这是亨克第二队对阵瓦斯兰-贝弗伦的比赛。你的第一个进球是对阵谁？我记得我很小的时候就进球过一次！那是在很小的球场上，我为布尔森效力。它将永远留在我的脑海里！你还记得第一次有人在公共场合认出你是什么时候吗？那是我在亨克的时候，我开始在那里踢一些比赛。我还记得一点点。当你加盟切尔西时，你的第一感觉是什么？当然，这太棒了。世界上最大的球队之一。你不需要太多的说服就能做到这一点！

news.title: Chelsea Women's Constant Contact September Goal of the Month revealed!
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足 9 月持续接触进球揭晓！
news.body_en: Wieke Kaptein's sublime strike against Austria Vienna in the UEFA Women's Champions League has been voted as our Constant Contact Goal of the Month for September! The Dutch midfielder broke the deadlock in our opening Champions League league-phase fixture, picking up a loose ball 30 yards from goal before taking two touches to beat a defender and thundering an effort off the underside of the crossbar. Kaptein hit the ball sweetly beyond the powerless goalkeeper to give us a memorable winner. Our No. 19 has played a big role in our unbeaten start to the campaign, featuring in all nine games so far this season and starting in eight of those encounters. Her strike was the clear winner among Blues fans, receiving 41 per cent of all votes cast. Alyssa Thompson's winner against Arsenal finished second with 14 per cent, while Lauren James' fine strike against Aston Villa and Lexi Potter's effort against Birmingham both received 10 per cent to share third place.

news.title: OTD: Jimmy Floyd thumps in four!
news.title_zh: OTD：吉米·弗洛伊德四分命中！
news.body_en: Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink had already endeared himself to Blues supporters when he hit new heights a couple of months into his Chelsea career, smashing four goals in against Coventry City at Stamford Bridge 26 years ago today. Jimmy joined from Atletico Madrid in the summer of 2000 and opened his account for the Blues in the 2-0 Community Shield win over Manchester United at Wembley. He then bagged on his Premier League debut for us, too, with his next three goals coming against Arsenal, Manchester United and Liverpool. Coventry arrived at the Bridge on Saturday 21 October 2000 fresh from beating Tottenham, but they were blown away by a superb Chelsea display that showcased what our side, with newly-appointed Claudio Ranieri at the helm, was capable of. Hasselbaink won and then converted a penalty in the 25th minute to get the rout underway, and he doubled our lead shortly before the break with a bending effort having cut in from the left flank. It was a goal we would see many times again! After Gianfranco Zola had made it 3-0, Hasselbaink completed his hat-trick with a tap-in - although one of the more emphatic variety, of course! - and then bagged his fourth with another pinpoint finish. His quartet of goals were scored in just 33 minutes. Sub Tore-Andre Flo added a sixth with what would prove his final Chelsea goal before departing for Rangers, with Ed de Goey's clean sheet spoiled by Cedric Roussel in the 89th minute. Still, there was no doubt who the day belonged to. Hasselbaink finished as the Premier League's top goalscorer with 23 goals, and there was no more profitable day than his one against Coventry at the Bridge.
news.body_zh: 吉米·弗洛伊德·哈塞尔巴因克 (Jimmy Floyd Hasselbaink) 在切尔西职业生涯几个月后达到了新的高度，26 年前的今天在斯坦福桥对阵考文垂城的比赛中攻入四个进球，当时他已经赢得了蓝军球迷的喜爱。吉米于2000年夏天从马德里竞技加盟，并在温布利社区盾杯2-0战胜曼联的比赛中为蓝军打开了自己的账户。随后他也为我们完成了英超首秀，接下来的三个进球分别是对阵阿森纳、曼联和利物浦。 2000 年 10 月 21 日星期六，考文垂刚刚击败托特纳姆热刺队抵达蓝桥，但他们被切尔西队的精彩表现所震撼，这展示了我们球队在新任命的克劳迪奥·拉涅利的带领下的能力。哈塞尔巴因克获胜，并在第 25 分钟罚进点球，帮助球队开始溃败，在中场休息前不久，他从左翼切入一记弧线射门，将我们的领先优势扩大了一倍。这是一个我们会多次看到的进球！在詹弗兰科·佐拉 (Gianfranco Zola) 将比分改写为 3-0 后，哈塞尔巴因克 (Hasselbaink) 的一脚攻门完成了帽子戏法 - 当然，这是更为有力的变种之一！ - 然后又以精准的射门收获了第四个进球。他的四个进球仅用了33分钟就打进了。替补托雷-安德烈·弗洛打入第六球，这也是他在前往流浪者队之前的最后一个切尔西进球，埃德·德·戈伊的不失球在第 89 分钟被塞德里克·鲁塞尔破坏。尽管如此，这一天属于谁是毫无疑问的。哈塞尔巴因克以 23 个进球成为英超最佳射手，没有比他在蓝桥对阵考文垂的比赛更赚钱的一天了。

news.title: Lexi Potter on a whirlwind few weeks for club and country
news.title_zh: 莱克西·波特在俱乐部和国家队的几周旋风
news.body_en: The rise of Lexi Potter from Chelsea Academy graduate to regularly featuring for Sonia Bompastor’s team and earning her first senior England cap may come as a surprise to some, but those who have followed her career closely will have understood she was destined for the top. Breaking records from an early age, Potter became the youngest player in women’s football history to sign a professional contract when she penned her first deal at Chelsea in 2023 at the age of 17. After two successful campaigns on loan with Crystal Palace, the midfielder earned her first Blues appearance at the start of last season when she came on as a 72nd-minute substitute in our 4-0 win against Paris FC in October. By March, she had played her way to a first-team start, which came at home against Brighton & Hove Albion. Bompastor’s faith was rewarded with a goal from Potter in a 2-1 win over the Seagulls. It was a sign of what was to come. After ten games in all competitions this season, the 20-year-old has featured nine times, scoring once. In the Women’s Super League, she has played 376 minutes - only seven of our players have spent more time on the pitch than Potter. Of course then, it was no wonder that she was on England head coach Sarina Wiegman’s radar when it was time to make her selections for the October internationals. And sure enough, she became England Women’s legacy number 244 when she was named on the teamsheet against Greece in Leicester. Shy and humble, Potter says she’s not yet processed making her senior England debut. But if her form is anything to go by, the spotlight on her is not going away anytime soon. ‘No, not yet,’ she says when asked if the night at the King Power Stadium has sunk in. ‘It's been a quick turnaround from the international break to coming back at Chelsea, but it's been a really good few weeks, and definitely a time I'll never forget. 244 🦁 ❤️Lexi Potter is set to make her #Lionesses debut tonight! 👊 pic.twitter.com/CTrtTOyMxu ‘It was really special. It's something that you always work towards as a young girl, and I'm very grateful and very proud to have done that.’ If anything were to highlight how Potter has remained grounded, it’s how she describes getting the call from Wiegman. ‘I was just at home, in my room, and I wasn't expecting it at all,’ she explains. ‘So when I got the call, I was really happy and very excited.’ Chelsea supporters have seen Potter’s relationship with Keira Walsh blossom on and off the field at club level. That meant the youngster had a ready-made mentor when she joined the senior England camp earlier this month. ‘There aren't many players better in the number six role than Keira to learn from, and I'm very lucky to get the opportunity to be playing alongside her at the moment,’ Potter continued. ‘There are a lot of things in her game that I can learn from and hopefully add to mine, but as the minutes go by, hopefully the partnership will just continue to get stronger. Hopefully we can go very far.’ On current evidence, it appears that the partnership will continue to go far, as Potter suggests. For both club and country.
news.body_zh: 莱克西·波特从切尔西学院毕业，成为索尼娅·邦帕斯特队的常客，并首次代表英格兰国家队出场，这可能会让一些人感到惊讶，但那些密切关注她职业生涯的人会明白她注定会登上顶峰。波特从小就打破纪录，2023年，年仅17岁的波特在切尔西签下了自己的第一笔合同，成为女足历史上签下职业合同最年轻的球员。在租借到水晶宫两次成功的赛季后，这位中场球员在上赛季初首次为蓝军出场，在10月份我们4-0战胜巴黎FC的比赛中，她在第72分钟替补出场。到了三月，她在主场对阵布莱顿的比赛中以自己的方式在一线队首发。庞帕斯托的信念得到了回报，波特的进球帮助球队 2-1 战胜了海鸥队。这是即将发生的事情的征兆。本赛季各项赛事出场十场后，这位20岁的球员出场九次，打进一球。在女足超级联赛中，她出场了 376 分钟——我们的球员中只有 7 人比波特在球场上花费的时间更长。当然，当英格兰队主教练萨琳娜·维格曼（Sarina Wiegman）为十月国际比赛选拔她时，也就不足为奇了。果然，当她在莱斯特城对阵希腊队的比赛中入选球队名单时，她就成为了英格兰女足的传奇号码 244 号。波特害羞而谦逊，她说她还没有准备好在英格兰成年队首秀。但如果从她的状态来看，她的聚光灯不会很快消失。 “不，还没有，”当被问及在王权球场的夜晚是否已经深入人心时，她说道。“从国际比赛日到回到切尔西，这是一个很快的转变，但这几周真的很美好，绝对是我永远不会忘记的时光。” 244 🦁❤️莱克西·波特今晚将首次亮相#Lionesses！ 👊 pic.twitter.com/CTrtTOyMxu “这真的很特别。这是你作为一个年轻女孩总是要努力实现的目标，我非常感激并且非常自豪能够做到这一点。”如果有什么事情能够凸显波特是如何保持脚踏实地的，那就是她如何描述接到韦格曼的电话。 “我当时只是在家里，在我的房间里，我根本没想到会发生这种事，”她解释道。 “所以当我接到电话时，我真的很高兴也很兴奋。”切尔西的支持者们看到了波特与凯拉·沃尔什在俱乐部球场内外的关系蓬勃发展。这意味着当这位年轻球员本月早些时候加入英格兰成年队训练营时，她已经有了一位现成的导师。 “在六号位上，没有多少球员比凯拉更值得学习，我很幸运现在有机会与她并肩作战，”波特继续说道。 “她的比赛中有很多东西我可以学习，并希望能补充到我的东西中，但随着时间的流逝，希望我们的合作关系能够继续变得更加牢固。”希望我们能走得更远。”根据目前的证据，正如波特所暗示的那样，这种伙伴关系似乎将继续走得更远。对于俱乐部和国家队来说。

news.title: Danny Welbeck on leadership, family and honouring our communities
news.title_zh: 丹尼·维尔贝克谈领导力、家庭和尊重我们的社区
news.body_en: As part of Black History Month, Chelsea FC and Football Black List brought together Danny Welbeck and Football Black List co-founder Leon Mann for a conversation on leadership, family and community. It reflects Chelsea’s ‘Beyond Blue’ approach: building a more inclusive culture, increasing representation and tackling bias in any form. Danny highlights the importance of giving everyone a voice and creating a safe environment. The conversation also ties into this year’s theme, 'Honouring Our Communities'. Danny reflects on how his family shaped his career, his values and his approach to leadership. He and Leon discuss what leadership means in football today, the value of positive role models, and the responsibility experienced players have to support and create opportunities for the next generation. Football Black List celebrates the achievements of Black professionals across football, with African and Caribbean heritage at its heart. Co-founded by Leon Mann and Rodney Hinds, it champions Black excellence, increases visibility and representation, and backs the next generation of leaders in the game. Watch the extended Danny Welbeck × Leon Mann conversation with Football Black List below.
news.body_zh: 作为黑人历史月的一部分，切尔西足球俱乐部和足球黑名单将丹尼·维尔贝克和足球黑名单联合创始人莱昂·曼聚集在一起，就领导力、家庭和社区进行了对话。它反映了切尔西的“超越蓝色”方法：建立更具包容性的文化，增加代表性并解决任何形式的偏见。丹尼强调了让每个人都有发言权和创造安全环境的重要性。这次对话也与今年的主题“尊重我们的社区”相关。丹尼反思了他的家庭如何塑造他的职业生涯、价值观和领导方式。他和莱昂讨论了领导力在当今足球界的意义、积极榜样的价值，以及经验丰富的球员为下一代提供支持和创造机会的责任。 《足球黑名单》庆祝黑人专业人士在足球领域取得的成就，以非洲和加勒比传统为核心。该组织由莱昂·曼 (Leon Mann) 和罗德尼·海因兹 (Rodney Hinds) 共同创立，倡导黑人的卓越品质，提高知名度和代表性，并支持下一代运动领袖。请观看下面丹尼·维尔贝克 × 莱昂·曼与《足球黑名单》的延长对话。

news.title: Mike Penders breaks 21-year Chelsea record after Premier League debut
news.title_zh: 迈克·潘德斯 (Mike Penders) 首次亮相英超打破切尔西 21 年纪录
news.body_en: Mike Penders became Chelsea’s youngest goalkeeper in Premier League history when he replaced Emiliano Martinez in the second half of Saturday’s victory at Everton. The Belgian came on to make his English top-flight debut at the age of 21 years and 78 days, surpassing Lenny Pidgeley as our youngest keeper in the league since 1992. While Penders now holds the Premier League record for the Blues, our all-time youngest goalkeeper remains Kingsley Whiffen. Whiffen was just 16 years and 157 days old when he made his solitary appearance away to Leicester City in Division One in 1967. Whiffen is followed by Steve Francis (17 years, 130 days) and Les Fridge (17 years, 251 days) as our youngest keepers. Here is a closer look at the five youngest goalkeepers to feature for Chelsea in the Premier League era after Penders broke the record, which had stood for over 20 years… Penders was called into action as a second-half substitute at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Saturday, replacing the injured Martinez. The young Belgian, who spent last season on loan at Strasbourg, showed great composure under pressure. One dominant punch on the edge of the box caught the eye as he helped us see out a first league clean sheet since January. Charlton Athletic (h) – 7 May 2005 Academy graduate Pidgeley previously held the Premier League record. Pidgeley was our third-choice keeper, behind the great Petr Cech and Carlo Cudicini, in the title-winning seasons of 2004/05 and 2005/06. He made his Blues bow on the day we lifted the Premier League trophy for the first time, brought on by Jose Mourinho late into our eventual 1-0 success over Charlton. He played one more game the following season before moving on to Millwall. Manchester United (h) – 15 August 2004 Petr Cech was not long 22 when he made his Chelsea debut on the opening day of that incredible 2004/05 season. He kept a clean sheet against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge, setting the tone for a record-breaking campaign and career. Cech has kept the most clean sheets in Premier League history, and at Chelsea went on to win four Premier League titles, four FA Cups and, of course, the Champions League. After three successful years on loan at Atletico Madrid, Thibaut Courtois returned to Stamford Bridge to make his Premier League debut on the opening weekend of the 2014/15 season. The towering Belgian displaced Cech between the posts that year, helping the Blues claim the Premier League title. Southampton (a) – 4 December 2024 Rounding off the top five is Filip Jorgensen. Having signed from Villarreal in the summer of 2024, Jorgensen made his first Premier League appearance during a big midweek victory against Southampton. news.body_zh: 迈克·潘德斯在周六战胜埃弗顿的下半场比赛中取代埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯，成为切尔西英超历史上最年轻的门将。比利时人以 21 岁零 78 天的年龄首次在英格兰顶级联赛上场，超越兰尼·皮吉利，成为自 1992 年以来联赛中最年轻的门将。虽然潘德斯现在保持着蓝军英超联赛的纪录，但我们历史上最年轻的门将仍然是金斯利·惠芬。 1967 年，惠芬在一级联赛客场对阵莱斯特城的比赛中单独亮相时，年仅 16 岁零 157 天。紧随惠芬之后的是史蒂夫·弗朗西斯（17 岁零 130 天）和莱斯·弗里奇（17 岁零 251 天），他们是我们最年轻的门将。以下是彭德斯打破了保持了 20 多年的纪录后，英超时代为切尔西出场的五名最年轻门将的详细资料……周六，彭德斯在希尔迪金森体育场下半场替补出场，取代了受伤的马丁内斯。这位上赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡的年轻比利时人在压力下表现出了极大的冷静。他在禁区边缘的一记极具统治力的一拳引人注目，帮助我们取得了自一月份以来的首场联赛不失球。查尔顿竞技队（主）——2005 年 5 月 7 日 学院毕业生皮吉利此前保持着英超联赛纪录。在 2004/05 赛季和 2005/06 赛季夺冠期间，皮吉利是我们的第三门将，仅次于伟大的切赫和库迪奇尼。在我们最终1-0战胜查尔顿的比赛中，穆里尼奥在我们首次捧起英超奖杯的那天，他为蓝军鞠了一躬。在接下来的一个赛季，他又打了一场比赛，然后转会到米尔沃尔。曼联（主）——2004 年 8 月 15 日 彼得·切赫 (Petr Cech) 在 2004/05 赛季的开幕日上演切尔西首秀时还不到 22 岁。他在斯坦福桥对阵曼联的比赛中保持不失球，为破纪录的赛季和职业生涯奠定了基调。切赫保持了英超历史上最多的不失球纪录，并在切尔西赢得了四次英超冠军、四次足总杯冠军，当然还有欧冠冠军。在马德里竞技队租借三年并取得成功后，蒂博·库尔图瓦回到斯坦福桥，并在 2014/15 赛季的首周末上演了他的英超首秀。这位身材高大的比利时人在那一年取代了切赫，帮助蓝军夺得了英超冠军。南安普顿 (客) – 2024 年 12 月 4 日 菲利普·乔根森 (Filip Jorgensen) 跻身前五。约根森于 2024 年夏天从比利亚雷亚尔签约，在周中战胜南安普顿的比赛中首次亮相英超联赛。他在我们那个赛季胜利的欧足联会议联赛中发挥了重要作用，并且还在世俱杯中出场，帮助我们捧起了更多的奖杯。 21 年 78 天 |埃弗顿 (客) (替补) | 17/10/2026 莱尼·皮吉利 | 21 岁 90 天 |查尔顿竞技 (主) (替补) | 07/05/2005 彼得·切赫 | 22 岁 87 天 |曼联 (主) | 15/08/2004 蒂博·库尔图瓦 | 22 岁 99 天 |伯恩利 (客) | 18/08/2014 菲利普·乔根森 | 22 年 232 天 |南安普顿 (客) | 2024年4月12日

news.title: PGA Division 1 report: Chelsea Women Under-18s 5-1 Tottenham Hotspur
news.title_zh: PGA Division 1 报告：切尔西 18 岁以下女子 5-1 托特纳姆热刺
news.body_en: Chelsea Women Under-18s, who play in the PGA Under-21 Women's League, began our Women’s PGA National League Division 1 campaign with a 5-1 victory over Tottenham Hotspur at Cobham, with Manaka Matsukubo scoring a hat-trick. Spurs took the lead with just 15 seconds on the clock, but Matsukubo levelled on eight minutes and Lola Brown struck twice before half-time to put the Blues in control. Matsukubo added two more after the break, completing her hat-trick with a superb volley on 70 minutes. First-team players Brown, Nelly Las, Chloe Sarwie and Matsukubo were all involved for Leanne Champ’s side. It was Brown’s third appearance for the Under-18s, while Las, Sarwie and Matsukubo each made their second appearance for the team this season. Spurs went ahead straight from kick-off. A long ball forward was not cleared by the Chelsea defence and midfield, and Nife Aramide collected on the edge of the area before finding the bottom corner. The early lead did not last long. Matsukubo was unable to convert at the end of a Rebekah Pierce cross, but Keira Johnson (pictured top) quickly won the ball back on the edge of the area and slid it through for Matsukubo, who calmly placed her finish past the onrushing Sophie Jackson. A rapid counter-attack put Chelsea ahead before the half-hour mark. Matsukubo cleared the ball from our own box and Chelsea N’Drin recovered it, allowing Brown to drive forward into the Spurs half. A well-timed one-two with Matsukubo took Brown into the box, where she cut onto her left foot and finished at the near post. Brown added a third as half-time approached. She pressed a Spurs goal-kick aggressively, intercepted a pass from the goalkeeper and quickly passed into a virtually empty net. Champ made three changes at the break, with Elise Christian, Stevie Sinclair and Jahmya Putman replacing Gabi Storey, Johnson and N’Drin. Sophie Leach came on for Sarwie on 61 minutes. The Blues scored a fourth on 63 minutes. Matsukubo found Pierce out wide on the left, and as Pierce drove inside she laid the ball off to Matsukubo on the overlap. Matsukubo jinked past three Spurs defenders in the box and bent her shot into the far corner. She saved the best for last seven minutes later. A headed clearance from a Chelsea corner fell to Matsukubo on the edge of the box, and she controlled it on her chest before chipping it past an onrushing defender, setting herself up for a left-footed volley into the far corner to make it 5-1. Chelsea have started our Division 1 campaign with a strong win and sit second in the table, behind the leaders only on goal difference. The Blues now have a two-week break before returning to Women’s National League Cup action on Sunday 1 November. We travel to Oxford United Women in the first knockout round, facing a side who are top of the third tier and unbeaten. Chelsea (3-4-3): Victoria Rudz; Gabi Storey (Elise Christian 45), Sadie Gregory, Chloe Sarwie (Sophie Leach 61); Nelly Las, Keira Johnson (Stevie Sinclair 45), Belle Sullivan, Rebekah Pierce; Manaka Matsukubo (Zoe Ciccardini 75), Lola Brown, Chelsea N’Drin (Jahmya Putman 45)Scorers: Matsukubo 8, 63, 70, Brown 28, 40Manager: Leanne Champ
news.body_zh: 参加 PGA 21 岁以下女子联赛的切尔西 18 岁以下女子队在科巴姆以 5-1 战胜托特纳姆热刺队，开始了女子 PGA 国家联赛第 1 级的比赛，松久保爱中 (Manaka Matsukubo) 上演了帽子戏法。热刺在比赛还剩 15 秒时取得领先，但松久保在第 8 分钟扳平比分，洛拉·布朗在半场结束前梅开二度帮助蓝军掌控局势。中场休息后松久保再进两球，在第 70 分钟凭借一记精彩的抽射完成帽子戏法。一线队球员布朗、内莉·拉斯、克洛伊·萨尔维和松久保都参加了莉安·钱普的球队。这是布朗第三次代表U-18 队出场，而拉斯、萨尔维和松久保则是本赛季第二次代表球队出场。热刺一开球就直接领先。一名长传前锋没有被切尔西防守和中场解围，尼夫·阿拉米德在禁区边缘接球，然后找到底角。早期的领先优势并没有持续多久。丽贝卡·皮尔斯 (Rebekah Pierce) 传中后，松久保未能完成转换，但凯拉·约翰逊 (上图) 很快在禁区边缘夺回球权，并将球传给松久保，松久保冷静地将球射过冲上来的索菲·杰克逊 (Sophie Jackson)。半小时前，切尔西凭借快速反击取得领先。松久保将球从我们的禁区内解围，切尔西恩德林将球接回，让布朗带球进入热刺半场。布朗与松久保在一次恰到好处的二过一中将布朗带入禁区，她用左脚切入近门柱。半场结束时，布朗再进一球。她积极地逼抢热刺球门球，拦截守门员的传球，并迅速将球传入几乎空门。中场休息时，钱普做出了三项调整，埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安、史蒂夫·辛克莱和贾米亚·普特曼取代了加比·斯托里、约翰逊和恩德林。第 61 分钟，索菲·利奇 (Sophie Leach) 替下萨尔维 (Sarwie)。蓝军在第 63 分钟取得第四球。松久保在左侧找到了皮尔斯，当皮尔斯突破内线时，她将球传给了重叠处的松久保。松久保在禁区内突破了三名热刺后卫，将射门射入远角。她在最后七分钟后保存了最好的成绩。切尔西角球中的头球解围落在禁区边缘的松久保身上，她将球控制在胸前，然后将球越过冲上来的后卫，左脚抽射入远角，将比分改写为5-1。切尔西以一场强劲的胜利开始了我们的一级联赛，目前在积分榜上排名第二，仅以净胜球之差落后于领头羊。蓝军现在有两周的休息时间，然后才能在 11 月 1 日星期日重返女子全国联赛杯比赛。我们将在第一轮淘汰赛中对阵牛津联女足，对手是一支第三梯队的顶级球队且保持不败。切尔西（3-4-3）：维多利亚·鲁兹； Gabi Storey（Elise Christian 45）、Sadie Gregory、Chloe Sarwie（Sophie Leach 61）； Nelly Las、Keira Johnson（Stevie Sinclair 45）、Belle Sullivan、Rebekah Pierce； Manaka Matsukubo (Zoe Ciccardini 75)、Lola Brown、Chelsea N’Drin (Jahm​​ya Putman 45)得分手：Matsukubo 8、63、70、Brown 28、40经理：Leanne Champ

news.title: Rachael Adedini signs first professional contract with Chelsea
news.title_zh: 雷切尔·阿德迪尼 (Rachael Adedini) 与切尔西签订第一份职业合同
news.body_en: Chelsea can confirm that promising young forward Rachael Adedini has signed her first contract as a professional with the club. A dynamic and versatile forward, Adedini is a central striker, and can also play out wide. The 17-year-old has represented France Under-17s on 24 occasions and has played at Under-19 level twice. On putting pen to paper on her first professional deal, Adedini said: ‘I'm very happy to be here. I'm excited, and I'm grateful to be here. ‘I'm thankful to God, and the reason behind this is because my brother's a big fan, and we've always loved Chelsea, so playing here today is a massive pride for me and my family.’ The young forward was born in Le Havre in France. She has played at three consecutive Women’s Under-17 European Championships since the 2023/24 campaign and has stood out with nine goals in total. That strike rate has seen her equal Germany’s Shekiera Martinez as the all-time top scorer at the Women's Under-17 Euros. France made the final in 2026, narrowly losing to Germany with a 1-0 defeat. Adedini finished the tournament with the Golden Boot award after scoring in a 5-0 win over Poland and netting a brace in a 4-1 victory over Finland in the group stages. Everyone at Chelsea extends a warm welcome to Rachael, and we look forward to watching her progress.
news.body_zh: 切尔西可以确认，有前途的年轻前锋雷切尔·阿德迪尼已经与俱乐部签署了她作为职业球员的第一份合同。阿德迪尼是一名充满活力、多才多艺的前锋，是一名中锋，也可以踢边路。这位 17 岁的球员曾 24 次代表法国 U-17 队参赛，并两次参加过 U-19 级别比赛。在签署她的第一份职业合同时，阿德迪尼说：“我很高兴来到这里。我很兴奋，也很感激来到这里。 “我感谢上帝，这背后的原因是因为我哥哥是切尔西的忠实粉丝，而且我们一直都很喜欢切尔西，所以今天在这里比赛对我和我的家人来说是一个巨大的骄傲。”这位年轻的前锋出生在法国勒阿弗尔。自2023/24赛季以来，她已连续三届参加女子17岁以下欧洲锦标赛，并总共打入9粒进球，脱颖而出。这一进球率使她追平了德国选手谢基拉·马丁内斯 (Shekiera Martinez)，成为女子 17 岁以下欧洲杯历史最佳射手。法国队闯入2026年决赛，以0比1险胜德国队。阿德迪尼在小组赛5-0战胜波兰的比赛中梅开二度，并在4-1战胜芬兰的比赛中梅开二度，获得了本届世界杯的金靴奖。切尔西的每个人都热烈欢迎瑞秋，我们期待看到她的进步。

news.title: George Weah recalls his ‘historic’ debut derby winner against Tottenham
news.title_zh: 乔治·维阿回忆起他对阵托特纳姆热刺的“历史性”德比首秀
news.body_en: All Chelsea eyes are looking ahead to Saturday’s derby with Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge. In the corresponding fixture just over a quarter-of-a-century ago, George Weah lit up a cold winter’s night by heading his name into Blues folklore with the winning goal on his debut. The megastar striker’s stay in west London wasn’t a long one, but he knew how to make an impression. There was a tangible sense of bristling excitement inside Stamford Bridge as Weah made his way to the touchline to prepare for his Chelsea debut early in the second half of a feisty league game against Tottenham in January 2000. The 1995 Ballon d’Or winner had only flown into London a few hours earlier, signing the relevant paperwork on a loan deal from AC Milan before making his way to the ground, where he was immediately named as a substitute by Blues boss Gianluca Vialli. Now, he was preparing to make his debut in the 56th minute of a floodlit London derby. The Liberian striker was one of the biggest names in world football at the time. He had been one of Milan’s star turns at a time when Serie A was the strongest league in Europe, and everyone had seen his famous goal against Verona in 1996, when he had picked up the ball inside his own box then proceeded to run the length of the pitch before guiding the ball into the far corner. However, the 33-year-old had fallen out of favour at the San Siro by the midway point of the 1999/2000 season and Chelsea – who had topped the UEFA Champions League group that Milan had propped up earlier that season – reacted quickest to the news that he might be available. Vialli wasted no time in putting him in the team, either, and when he emerged from the bench wearing Chelsea blue for the first time, Weah’s mere presence triggered an audible buzz, which broke into a monumental cheer as the world-famous striker entered the fray. Half-an-hour later, he was celebrating the winning goal – the only goal of the game – three minutes from time, in front of the Shed End. His powerful leap at the back post had taken him a full foot higher than Stephens Carr and Clemence, who floundered as Weah headed Dennis Wise’s cross past Ian Walker. His eyes wide with delight under the floodlights, Weah’s celebrations dominated the back pages the following morning. ‘Weah on the march with Luca’s army!’ read the headline on the inside back page of the Daily Mirror, punning on defeated Spurs’ famous FA Cup final song, while the looks of delight on the faces of his team-mates Jon Harley and Chris Sutton seemed to be derived almost as much from the presence of Weah in their midst as from the delirium of a late victory over our London rivals. He reflected on that moment a decade later in an interview for our official website. ‘My time with Chelsea was excellent – I came in for half a season and in the most important game, the first game, Chelsea won and I scored,’ recalled Weah. ‘It’s historical for me, it will forever remain in my mind and my heart, it was the day I came to Chelsea and I scored.’ Back-to-back draws in their previous two games had left Vialli with the feeling that he needed another option up front. The partnership of Tore Andre Flo and Gianfranco Zola was suffering a mid-season crisis of confidence, while big-money summer signing Sutton had failed to settle in. Weah’s arrival changed that, as Vialli decided to partner the Liberian with Sutton, viewing the physically imposing duo as an alternative double act to Zola and Flo. Sutton relished the chance to link up with the new arrival and teed up Weah for the second goal in our 2-1 win over Leicester City in the FA Cup fifth round. Up against a physical side, Vialli went for the lesser-spotted large and large partnership up top, and Sutton sent his man sprawling to the floor before pulling the ball back for Weah to sweep home across the goalkeeper. These days, Sutton’s rough stuff would almost certainly have been penalised by the officials, or their video assistants, but the goal stood and the Blues progressed past Martin O’Neill’s towering side after matching them for aggression and spirit. In the following round, against Gillingham at Stamford Bridge, Weah produced a moment of magic that drew gasps from the stands, casually leaning forward in the centre circle in anticipation of a dropping ball and flicking a volleyed pass over his head with his heel. The audacious pass found its mark and it was the highlight of a 5-0 win, in which Weah also registered his third goal for the club. In total, he struck five times in 15 games for the Blues and signed off with an FA Cup winner’s medal after starting in our 1-0 win over Aston Villa in the 2000 final. The striker bounced around the old Wembley pitch following the last-ever cup final under those famous twin towers wearing a vest with a specially printed message for his son. ‘I believe in God, Timothy,’ it read. ‘I won the last FA Cup at Wembley before it was destroyed and that was a big impact for me, it is history for me,’ the legendary striker said of that day. ‘The FA Cup is one of the best competitions in the world and is a huge part of the English culture. ‘It is what I used to watch on television and then I was part of it, so again I have to thank all of the people that made it possible: Vialli, Zola, Dennis Wise, Chris Sutton, all those guys who wanted me to be successful and made me comfortable.’ After retiring from club football in 2003, Weah became involved in politics and was elected President of Liberia in 2017. Timothy – the subject of his inspirational printed message at Wembley in 2000 – has gone on to become a professional footballer himself, playing internationally for the USA, where he was born and raised, at the FIFA World Cup in 2022 and 2026. He also made an appearance against Chelsea during the 2021/22 season, when he came on as substitute for Lille in the first leg of our Champions League last-16 tie. A generation later, many a Blues fan raised a smile as the sight of the name ‘Weah’ on the team-sheet brought back found memories of derby victory at the Bridge. - A version of this article first appeared in the matchday programme in 2022. news.body_zh: 所有切尔西的目光都在期待周六在斯坦福桥与托特纳姆热刺队的德比。在四分之一个多世纪前的相应比赛中，乔治·维阿在首秀中攻入制胜一球，让自己的名字载入了蓝军民间传说，照亮了寒冷的冬夜。这位巨星前锋在伦敦西部停留的时间并不长，但他知道如何给人留下深刻的印象。 2000 年 1 月，在一场激烈的联赛对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中，下半场一开始，维阿就走向了边线，准备在切尔西的首秀，斯坦福桥内弥漫着一种明显的兴奋感。 这位 1995 年金球奖得主几个小时前才飞抵伦敦，签署了 AC 米兰租借协议的相关文件，然后才抵达球场，在那里他立即被蓝军主帅吉安卢卡任命为替补。维亚利.现在，他正准备在泛光灯下的伦敦德比比赛的第56分钟首次亮相。这位利比里亚前锋是当时世界足坛最知名的球员之一。当意甲是欧洲最强联赛时，他是米兰的明星球员之一，每个人都看过他在1996年对阵维罗纳的著名进球，当时他在自己的禁区里接球，然后跑过球场，然后将球带入远角。然而，这位33岁的球员在1999/2000赛季中期就在圣西罗失宠了，而切尔西——当时米兰在该赛季早些时候支持的欧冠联赛小组第一——对他可能上场的消息反应最快。维亚利也毫不犹豫地将他纳入球队，当他第一次穿着切尔西蓝球衣从替补席上出现时，维阿的出现就引发了一阵嗡嗡声，当这位世界著名前锋加入战斗时，现场爆发出巨大的欢呼声。半小时后，距离比赛结束还有三分钟，他在谢德恩德球场前庆祝制胜进球——全场唯一进球。他在后门柱上的有力跳跃使他比斯蒂芬斯·卡尔和克莱门斯高出了整整一英尺，当维阿头球攻过丹尼斯·怀斯的传中越过伊恩·沃克时，克莱门斯陷入了困境。维阿在泛光灯下睁大了眼睛，充满喜悦，第二天早上，他的庆祝活动占据了最后几页。 《每日镜报》内封页的标题是“维阿与卢卡的军队一起进军！”，双关语是击败热刺队著名的足总杯决赛歌曲，而他的队友乔恩·哈雷和克里斯·萨顿脸上的喜悦表情似乎既来自维阿在他们中间的存在，又来自我们最后战胜伦敦对手的狂喜。十年后，他在我们官方网站的采访中回顾了那一刻。 “我在切尔西的时光非常美好——我效力了半个赛季，在最重要的比赛，第一场比赛中，切尔西赢了，我进球了，”维阿回忆道。 “这对我来说是历史性的，它将永远留在我的脑海和心里，那是我来到切尔西并进球的那一天。”前两场比赛的背靠背平局让维亚利感觉他需要在锋线上另一个选择。托雷·安德烈·弗洛和吉安弗兰科·佐拉的搭档在赛季中期遭遇了信任危机，而夏天斥巨资签下的萨顿却未能安定下来。维阿的到来改变了这一点，维亚利决定让利比里亚人与萨顿搭档，将这对身体强壮的二人组视为佐拉和弗洛的替代双人组合。萨顿很享受与新援联手的机会，并在足总杯第五轮2-1战胜莱斯特城的比赛中为维阿打进了第二个进球。面对实力强劲的球队，维亚利选择了上场的大号搭档，萨顿将他的防守球员打倒在地，然后将球拉回给维阿，后者将球横过门将。如今，萨顿的粗鲁行为几乎肯定会受到裁判或他们的视频助理的处罚，但进球有效，蓝军在与马丁·奥尼尔的进攻和精神相匹配后，超越了马丁·奥尼尔的高大球队。在接下来的一轮中，在斯坦福桥对阵吉林汉姆的比赛中，维阿创造了一个神奇的时刻，让看台上的人都倒吸一口凉气，他在中圈随意地向前倾身，等待着球的落下，然后用脚后跟将一记凌空传球从头顶上弹过。 这记大胆的传球达到了目的，成为5-0获胜的亮点，维阿也为俱乐部打进了他的第三个进球。总共，他在为蓝军出战的 15 场比赛中攻入 5 球，并在 2000 年决赛 1-0 战胜阿斯顿维拉的比赛中首发出场，并获得了足总杯冠军奖牌。在著名的双子塔下举行的最后一场杯赛决赛结束后，这位前锋在旧温布利球场上跳跃，穿着一件背心，上面专门印有给他儿子的信息。 “我相信上帝，蒂莫西，”上面写着。 “我在温布利球场被毁之前赢得了上届足总杯冠军，这对我影响很大，对我来说这是历史，”这位传奇前锋谈到那天时说道。 “足总杯是世界上最好的赛事之一，也是英国文化的重要组成部分。 “这是我以前在电视上看到的，然后我就成为了其中的一部分，所以我要再次感谢所有让这一切成为可能的人：维亚利、佐拉、丹尼斯·怀斯、克里斯·萨顿，所有那些希望我成功并让我感到舒适的人。”2003年从俱乐部足球退役后，维阿开始涉足政治，并于2017年当选利比里亚总统。蒂莫西——他在温布利的鼓舞人心的印刷信息的主题2000 年，他自己也成为了一名职业足球运动员，在 2022 年和 2026 年的 FIFA 世界杯上为他出生和长大的美国队效力。他还在 2021/22 赛季对阵切尔西的比赛中出场，当时他在欧冠 16 强首回合比赛中替补里尔出场。一代人之后，当许多蓝军球迷看到球队名单上的“维阿”名字时，他们都露出了笑容，勾起他们对蓝桥德比胜利的回忆。 -
